jobs.occupation: PhD AI-based cardiovascular image analysis and modeling
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop deep learning methods to create digital twins of coronary arteries? And help interventional cardiologists make smarter, data-driven treatment decisions in real time? You will contribute to a translational research project aimed at improving the diagnosis and treatment of coronary artery disease and supporting clinical decision-making during catheterization procedures. The project brings together cardiovascular imaging, generative AI, and computational modeling to develop probabilistic digital twins of coronary arteries. The goal is to create patient-specific models that combine anatomical and hemodynamic information derived from routine clinical imaging. By providing quantitative insights into coronary anatomy, blood flow, pressure, and wall shear stress—together with information about model uncertainty—the project aims to support more precise, physiology-guided treatment decisions without the need for additional invasive measurements. The research is embedded within the Quantitative Healthcare Analysis (qurAI) group and conducted in close collaboration with the CARA Lab and clinical partners in the Netherlands and abroad. You will work with large, multi-center clinical datasets and contribute to translating advanced computational methods into clinically relevant applications. This PhD position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, cardiovascular engineering, and clinical medicine, with the potential to contribute directly to the future of personalized cardiovascular care. As a PhD candidate, you will work on improving the diagnosis and treatment of coronary artery disease, with a clear focus on clinical application during catheterization procedures. Your research sits at the intersection of medical image analysis, generative AI, and blood flow modeling. You will: develop deep generative models (such as latent diffusion models, implicit neural representations, and flow matching) for

uncertainty-aware 3D reconstruction of coronary anatomy from 2D X-ray angiography; develop physics-informed neural networks and graph-based neural operators for fast estimation of 3D coronary hemodynamics (velocity, pressure, and wall shear stress fields); design computational pipelines that integrate image-based anatomy, blood flow physics, and uncertainty quantification; validate the developed methods on retrospective multi-center clinical datasets, in collaboration with clinical partners in the Netherlands and abroad; critically assess model performance and interpret results in the context of clinical and hemodynamic relevance; write scientific articles for high-impact journals and present your findings at national and international conferences and workshops. You are a motivated researcher with a strong technical background and a genuine interest in applying artificial intelligence to real clinical problems. You are curious, creative, and rigorous: you enjoy developing new methods and you care deeply about thorough validation and their impact on patient care. You have: an MSc degree in biomedical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, physics or a related discipline; demonstrable experience with scientific programming (preferably in Python, including deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch); affinity with medical image analysis and computational modeling; experience with neural networks for image analysis, generative modeling, geometric deep learning or physics-informed machine learning, or you are willing to learn these quickly; strong collaboration skills: you enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team and feel comfortable interacting with clinicians; excellent English communication skills (speaking and writing); only applications in English will be considered. Experience with cardiovascular imaging or computational fluid dynamics is an advantage. A flying start to your career in scientific research, with the opportunity to obtain a PhD degree.

As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Testing and releasing equipment after repairs. Carrying out inspections and condition monitoring to identify wear, leaks, unusual noises, and performance issues. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Experience in industrial maintenance within a production or manufacturing environment. Knowledge of mechanical drives, bearings,

chains, gears, pneumatics, and basic hydraulics. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them. Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage but not required. Hier kom je te werken As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring our production and packaging lines operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. You will carry out preventive maintenance, resolve mechanical breakdowns, and contribute to continuous improvements while maintaining the highest food safety and hygiene standards.

jobs.description:
Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.

Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Superior Profissional, Licenciatura, Mestrado or comparable experience. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading organization in the Dutch superyacht industry. The company designs, engineers and builds custom-made luxury yachts for international clients. Every project is unique and requires close collaboration between design, engineering, production, suppliers and specialist partners. The working environment is technical, international and quality-driven, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation and tailor-made solutions.

jobs.description:
Who we are

ZOE, the Institute for Future-Fit Economies, is an independent think & do tank active in Germany and in Brussels . We are dedicated to policy-oriented research and evidence-driven advocacy for a futurefit economy. At the interface of politics, research, and civil society in the EU, we develop impulses for an economy that enables people to live well within planetary boundaries.

We offer:

- A motivating working environment in a small think & do tank that has become an established actor in Brussels in a short space of time
- A strategic, agile, value and purpose-oriented working style
- Flexibility of working time and place, supporting a healthy work-life-balance

The role

The Economics of a Green and Just Transition team is seeking a trainee to support policy and research work across several projects related to financing and implementing a green and just transition. The trainee will help develop content and analytical materials, contribute to EU-level policy analysis, and may also support an industry-focused project with a particular emphasis on Germany.

Key responsibilities

As part of a motivated and impact-driven team you will carry out a variety of tasks, including: − Background research and analysis on various topics

- Drafting content for reports, policy briefs and other publications
- Preparation of presentations and key documents
- Preparing briefings for key stakeholder meetings
- Support in monitoring of current economic policy events and debates
- Support in the organization of events (physical and online)

Core competences

We are looking for people that share our core principles: value orientation, sustainability, agility, selforganisation .

Your profile would include the following skills, background , and knowledge:

- Excellent command of English and German , both oral and written -
- Master’s degree in economics/ political economy /European studies /public policy
- Interest in economic policy topics like fiscal policy and industrial policy
- Ability to work independently and in teams
- Strong analytical skills
- Strategic mindset

In addition, some of the following competencies fit well into our team but are not a requirement: -

- Knowledge of legislative processes in the EU and/or Germany
- Qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
- Based in Brussels or Berlin

Conditions

We are looking for someone to join our team for 38 hours per week for 6 months. The position will start ideally in October 2026. We offer the possibility to work remotely from Germany , the Netherlands, or Belgium or to work from our offices in Cologne, Berlin, and Brussels.

The gross monthly salary for full-time is 2289 euros, prorated for fewer hours. The remuneration for this position is based on our internal salary framework, informed by the collective agreement of the public service of the Länder. For a full-time (38 hours) position, 30 holiday days are offered for one calendar year.

In addition to this, ZOE offers several benefits such as additional days off for volunteering and reimbursement for public transportation.

Diversity

We believe that our society’s behaviour disproportionately hurts the most marginali sed people – including people of colour, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTIQ people. We are committed to challenge this through our work for socially just development and by creating a diverse workplace at our organisation . Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people who are members of marginali sed communities.

Application procedure

Please send your applications by 30 August. Please send : a) your CV (max 3 pages), b) a motivation letter (400–500 words) explaining why you would like to work with ZOE Institute and c) a sample of your work (power point slides, publication, press release or similar) to applications@zoe-institut.de. Please do not attach a photo to your application. Please state “Economic Policy Trainee” in the subject line.
If we shortlist you for an interview, we will get back to you as soon as possible with dates for an online interview. In case of any questions please contact applications@zoe-institut.de. Thank you very much for your interest in ZOE Institute .

jobs.description:
Interested in exploring how the gut microbiome impacts the risk of diarrheal disease? This project aims to understand how the bacteria in children’s gut might protect them from diarrheal disease and also alter the evolution of antimicrobial resistance. Infants in low- and middle- income countries (LMIC) are disproportionately burdened by bacterial diarrheal diseases and infections with antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Bacterial diarrheal pathogens contributes significantly to infant mortality, with many classified as WHO AMR priority pathogens. Interventions are needed to prevent infections with bacterial enteropathogens and AMR. Our previous research showed that there are differences in the E coli colonization of infants’ microbiome between LMIC vs. high-income countries (HIC). The airm of this PhD project is to understand how E. coli colonization contributes tot he risk of diarrheal disease and infections with AMR and use this knowledge to design interventions that protectLMIC infants from both. This is a 4 year PhD project based at the Amsterdam UMC's Department of Global Health, building on collaborations with the Centers for Infectious DIsease Research in Zambia, the University of Ghana, and Kenya Medicral Research Institute. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. The PhD _tudent will first use existing datasets to identify bacterial, host and environmental determinants of E. coli carriage, bacterial diarrheal infections, and AMR gene (ARG) carriage in infants. They will then support two clinical studies in Kenya and Zambia, assessing whether E. coli carriage contributes to Enterobacteriaceae colonization and ARG transmission. Finally, the PhD _tudent will use agent-based modeling to simulate colonization resistance and ARG transmission dynamics, guiding the design of microbiome-based interventions. Collectively, this work will clarify the role of E. coli in infant gut ecolog

support dvelopment of ARG endpoints in late-stage enteric vaccine trials and identify new strategies to reduce AMR and bacterial infections in at-risk LMIC infants. We are looking for an ambitious PhD candidate to study the interaction between E coli carriage, bacterial gastroenteritis and risk of AMR infections in infants in LMIC settings. Supportive expertise for the position include: Microbiology, microbiome & AMR expertise: Strong understanding of gut microbial ecology, antimicrobial resistance, and ideally metagenomics or microbial genomics. Quantitative, statistical & bioinformatics skills Experience analysing complex longitudinal datasets, proficiency in R and/or Python, and familiarity with bioinformatics workflows for microbiome, genomic, or ARG data. Computational modeling & systems thinking Strong quantitative aptitude and interest in agent-based modeling, simulation, and integrating bacterial, host, and environmental determinants of colonization and transmission. Clinical research Ability to support clinical studies in international/LMIC settings Key qualities for the researcher include: Capacity for interdisciplinary work, international collaboration, & strong communication skills. The candidate should work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, manage research activities independently, and communicate findings clearly in writing and presentations. Capacity to work within an international, multidisciplinary teams while progressively taking ownership of analyses and research questions. The candidate should be organized, curious, analytically rigorous and comfortable learning unfamiliar methods. Good written and spoken English is essential. Research motivation: a clear interest in global health, infant health, microbiome science and AMR, with an ability to translate mechanistic findings into clinically relevant questions and potential interventions. Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00). You will manage late arrivals, early departures, safety checks, and basic food and beverage preparation for the morning. This role requires high autonomy, a sharp eye for detail, and an absolute commitment to maintaining our premium boutique standards.

Functie-eisen:
What We Are Looking For
• Experience: Previous experience in hotel night auditing, front desk operations, or security/hospitality service is highly preferred.
• Reliability & Accountability: You are someone who understands that a small team relies heavily on your precision. You do not cut corners and take your job tasks seriously.
• Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken). Knowledge of Dutch or another European language is a great bonus.
• Legal Status: You must hold a valid EU passport or an unrestricted Dutch work permit with a valid BSN. We do not provide visa sponsorship.What We Offer
• A competitive part-time salary scaled to your experience in accordance with the Horeca-CAO, including applicable night-shift allowances.
• A safe, beautiful, and premium working environment in Amsterdam.
• Independence and trust to manage the property autonomously.

Even small things, such as getting in and out safely, staying alert when reversing, and paying attention to blind spots, make a big difference. If you want to refresh this knowledge, you can consider the training 'Updating professional competence for drivers'. This also falls under the Code 95 regulation.

 Four cities, and you pick yours

Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. • You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

jobs.employer_name: ZOE Institute for Future-Fit Economies gUG
jobs.description:
Who we are

ZOE, the Institute for Future-Fit Economies, is an independent think & do tank active in Germany and in Brussels . We are dedicated to policy-oriented research and evidence-driven advocacy for a futurefit economy. At the interface of politics, research, and civil society in the EU, we develop impulses for an economy that enables people to live well within planetary boundaries.

We offer:

- A motivating working environment in a small think & do tank that has become an established actor in Brussels in a short space of time
- A strategic, agile, value and purpose-oriented working style
- Flexibility of working time and place, supporting a healthy work-life-balance

The role

The Economics of a Green and Just Transition team is seeking a trainee to support policy and research work across several projects related to financing and implementing a green and just transition. The trainee will help develop content and analytical materials, contribute to EU-level policy analysis, and may also support an industry-focused project with a particular emphasis on Germany.

Key responsibilities

As part of a motivated and impact-driven team you will carry out a variety of tasks, including: − Background research and analysis on various topics

- Drafting content for reports, policy briefs and other publications
- Preparation of presentations and key documents
- Preparing briefings for key stakeholder meetings
- Support in monitoring of current economic policy events and debates
- Support in the organization of events (physical and online)

Core competences

We are looking for people that share our core principles: value orientation, sustainability, agility, selforganisation .

Your profile would include the following skills, background , and knowledge:

- Excellent command of English and German , both oral and written -
- Master’s degree in economics/ political economy /European studies /public policy
- Interest in economic policy topics like fiscal policy and industrial policy
- Ability to work independently and in teams
- Strong analytical skills
- Strategic mindset

In addition, some of the following competencies fit well into our team but are not a requirement: -

- Knowledge of legislative processes in the EU and/or Germany
- Qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
- Based in Brussels or Berlin

Conditions

We are looking for someone to join our team for 38 hours per week for 6 months. The position will start ideally in October 2026. We offer the possibility to work remotely from Germany , the Netherlands, or Belgium or to work from our offices in Cologne, Berlin, and Brussels.

The gross monthly salary for full-time is 2289 euros, prorated for fewer hours. The remuneration for this position is based on our internal salary framework, informed by the collective agreement of the public service of the Länder. For a full-time (38 hours) position, 30 holiday days are offered for one calendar year.

In addition to this, ZOE offers several benefits such as additional days off for volunteering and reimbursement for public transportation.

Diversity

We believe that our society’s behaviour disproportionately hurts the most marginali sed people – including people of colour, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTIQ people. We are committed to challenge this through our work for socially just development and by creating a diverse workplace at our organisation . Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people who are members of marginali sed communities.

Application procedure

Please send your applications by 30 August. Please send : a) your CV (max 3 pages), b) a motivation letter (400–500 words) explaining why you would like to work with ZOE Institute and c) a sample of your work (power point slides, publication, press release or similar) to applications@zoe-institut.de. Please do not attach a photo to your application. Please state “Economic Policy Trainee” in the subject line.
If we shortlist you for an interview, we will get back to you as soon as possible with dates for an online interview. In case of any questions please contact applications@zoe-institut.de. Thank you very much for your interest in ZOE Institute .

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

We are looking for a dedicated Weekend Night Receptionist (f/m/d) to ensure smooth and secure overnight operations across our hotels during weekends. This role is a combination of guest service, administrative, and accounting duties, requiring attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism. This role also includes light food & beverage duties, such as preparing and setting up the breakfast service for early morning guests.

Your profile
 
 

• Previous experience in hotel front office or night audit role preferred 

• Fluency in English and French (Dutch is a plus) 

• Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reconciliation 

• Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS); experience with Opera, Opera Cloud is a plus 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills 

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail  

Job requirements
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Front Desk Operations 
 
 

• Welcome and check-in late arrivals in a professional and friendly manner 

• Handle guest requests, inquiries, and complaints promptly and efficiently 

• Process check-outs and prepare bills for early departing guests 

• Ensure lobby and reception areas are clean and presentable during the night 

• Follow daily night checklist   

Night Audit and Reporting 
 
 

• Perform nightly audit of all hotel revenue, including rooms, food & beverage, and other outlets 

• Reconcile and balance daily transactions and post any necessary corrections 

• Prepare daily summary reports for management (e.g. occupancy, revenue, etc.) 

• Roll the date in the property management system (PMS) and close the business day  

Security and Safety 
 
 

• Monitor the property to ensure the safety and security of guests and staff 

• Follow emergency procedures and report any suspicious activity to management or security personnel 

• Conduct property walks and ensures all access points are secure  

Cash Handling 
 
 

• Reconcile the front desk cash drawer and ensure all transactions are properly accounted for

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?

At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.

This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.

You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

jobs.occupation: Junior Associate, Battery Passport & Sustainability Benchmarks M/W/X
jobs.description:
The Junior Associate will provide analytical and coordination support to the Battery Passport programme, with a particular focus on the Battery Benchmarks sustainability framework. The role combines standards and regulatory research, consultation analysis, drafting, data organisation and practical support to working groups, governance meetings and operations. 

This is a hands-on junior role in a small, internationally oriented team. It requires comfort moving between technical sustainability content, data handling and processing, and routine delivery tasks, including meeting administration, document control, stakeholder follow-up and event logistics. 

Key responsibilities 

Battery Benchmarks development 

• Analyse, catalogue and synthesise feedback from GBA member and public consultations. 
• Map voluntary ESG and responsible-sourcing standards relevant to battery and critical-mineral value chains. 
• Maintain regulatory and standards mappings and propose evidence-based updates to Battery Benchmarks modules and supporting documentation. 
• Support development of thematic modules. 
Assurance and credibility 

• Conduct background research on data assurance, verification, conformity assessment and certification approaches relevant to the Battery Passport. 
• Prepare comparisons, notes and materials for review by programme leads and external experts. 
Consultation and capacity building 

• Support the design and delivery of consultation surveys, webinars, outreach materials and the analysis of responses. 
• Draft and organise capacity-building and e-learning content using existing GBA frameworks and technical source material. 
Policy and regulatory monitoring 

• Monitor developments affecting batteries, critical minerals, sustainability reporting and responsible sourcing, and maintain a structured regulatory tracker. 
• Draft concise internal summaries and, where requested, first drafts of policy-facing materials. 
Working-group and Secretariat support 

• Prepare agendas, slide materials, minutes, action logs and member-input records for working groups, steering committees and governance meetings. 
• Support member-management processes, mailing lists, document repositories, event preparation, on-site delivery and post-event reporting. 
• Synthesise publications and market information into briefs, web copy or social-media drafts, and undertake other reasonable Secretariat tasks as required. 
• Excellent verbal and written communications in a culturally diverse and politically sensitive environment. 
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement AI-enabled workflows, including task-specific agents, to improve data handling, optimise internal processes, and support the ongoing maintenance of GBA standards and regulatory mappings.  
Required qualifications and experience 

• A completed master's degree in sustainable development, environmental policy or governance, international development, sustainability management, responsible business, supply-chain governance, or a closely related field. 
• Demonstrable professional experience analysing sustainability or ESG standards, regulatory frameworks and responsible-sourcing requirements in complex value chains. 
• Demonstrable research familiarity with battery or critical-mineral value chains, or with a closely comparable global industrial supply chain involving material environmental and human-rights risks. 
• Experience organising and analysing qualitative and quantitative information, including structured datasets, document review and synthesis of stakeholder input. 
• Ability to turn complex technical or policy material into accurate, concise written outputs for non-specialist and specialist audiences. 
• Strong organisational discipline, including document management, meeting preparation, minute-taking and follow-through on actions and deadlines. 
• Professional fluency in written and spoken English. 
• Ability to work from Brussels and to participate in occasional early-morning or late-afternoon international meetings; willingness to travel occasionally for GBA events. 
• The successful candidate must be legally entitled to work in Belgium before commencing employment. 
• Demonstrated experience using AI and data-analysis tools to develop efficient workflows, manage and interpret complex datasets, and support the ongoing maintenance of standards and regulatory frameworks. 
 

Desirable qualifications 

• Working knowledge of the EU Batteries Regulation and one or more relevant sustainability or reporting frameworks (for example GRI, ESRS/CSRD, responsible-minerals due diligence standards, EcoVadis or life-cycle assessment approaches). 
• Experience with stakeholder consultations, multi-stakeholder initiatives or expert workshops. 
• Applied capability in Excel and at least one data-analysis or visualisation tool such as Power BI, R or GIS. 
• Experience with collaborative platforms such as Microsoft 365, Teams and SharePoint. 
• Working knowledge of French or another language relevant to GBA's international stakeholder base. 
• Experience using carefully governed AI-assisted research or monitoring tools, with appropriate source checking and data-handling discipline.  
Working arrangements 

• The role is based in Brussels and involves close collaboration with a small Secretariat and external technical advisers. 
• Workload will vary with consultation, governance and event deadlines. Administrative and coordination work is an integral part of the position, not an incidental duty. 
• Some meetings are scheduled across international time zones, and occasional travel or on-site event support may be required.

Our analytics estate runs on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI: hundreds of workspaces, a large self-service community, and a regulated environment where access control, traceability and data integrity are not optional.

The platform is also moving fast. Copilot and data agents put generative AI in front of business users, Fabric IQ adds an ontology- based semantic layer, and Fabric Apps turn workspaces into a home for real, write-enabled applications each with its own tenant settings, capacity cost and compliance question. Someone has to decide how they get switched on, for whom, and under which controls.

We are looking for an administrator who treats the platform as a product: someone who automates rather than clicks, who can tell you exactly which capacity is throttling and why, and who keeps a GxP-relevant estate auditable without becoming a bottleneck for the business. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket queue.

Responsibilities

 
• Tenant & capacity administration:
  
   
• Tenant settings, domains, workspaces, capacities (F Skus) and delegated capacity settings.
   
• Capacity health and cost: smoothing, bursting, throttling, background vs. interactive operations. Right-size, forecast, and support chargeback to business units.
   
• Onelake, deployment pipelines, GIT integration and CI/CD for Fabric items (Fabric-CICD, Fabric REST APIs).
   
• On-premises and VNET GateWay clusters, connections, and service principal / workspace identity access to source systems (SNOW, Veeva, Edp, ERP).
   
• Incident response and root-cause analysis on refresh failures, performance degradation and access issues; evaluation of preview features before they reach users.
  
 
• Automation & monitoring, the core of this job:
  
   
• Fuam (Fabric Unified Admin Monitoring) as the backbone of tenant observability: deploy it, keep it current with upstream releases, extend it, and turn its output into operational decisions.
   
• Administration automated with PowerShell (Microsoftpowerbimgmt, AZ, Microsoft.Graph) and Python (semantic-link-labs, notebooks) against the Admin, Scanner and REST APIs: provisioning, access reviews, orphaned-item cleanup, licence reclamation, tenant-setting drift detection.
   
• That automation runs properly, Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Automation/Functions with logging, alerting and error handling.
   
• Observability beyond Fuam where needed: Workspace Monitoring (Eventhouse), Log Analytics, Capacity Metrics, Purview Audit.
  
 
• AI & new workloads:
  
   
• Copilot configuration: the Copilot and Azure Openai Service tenant settings, delegation to capacity administrators, security- group scoping, and the data-residency choices behind them.
   
• The cost of AI: Copilot and agents bill against capacity, so track Cu impact and assess whether a dedicated Fabric Copilot capacity makes sense.
   
• Fabric data agents: who may build them, on which sources, how they are validated, and what changes when they are surfaced through Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or MCP.
   
• Fabric IQ readiness (Ontology, graph, agents) and administration of Fabric Apps workload enablement, operational vs. data apps, the Rayfin CLI, and a review path for anything that writes data back.
  
 
• Governance & compliance:
  
   
• The workspace, domain and naming model, and the promotion path from self-service sandbox to certified content.
   
• Access through Entra ID groups and service principals: least privilege, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews and recertification.
   
• Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and DLP across Fabric and Power BI items.
   
• Qualification and validation...
  
...

• 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Fabric & Power BI administration

• Strong knowledge of Fabric tenant, workspace, Onelake, F-Sku capacity and GateWay administration

• Hands-on PowerShell & Python automation using Fabric Admin/REST APIs, Microsoft Graph and Microsoftpowerbimgmt

• Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD, GIT, Azure Automation/Functions and monitoring

• Strong expertise in Fabric capacity monitoring, performance, throttling, Cu consumption and cost optimization

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, RBAC, access reviews and security governanc

• Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, sensitivity labels and audit/lineage

• Experience with Fuam, Log Analytics, Eventhouse and Fabric monitoring

• Understanding of Fabric Copilot, Data Agents, Fabric IQ and AI workload governance

• Knowledge of GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and Alcoa+ compliance

Soft skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proactive and automation-oriented mindset

• Strong ownership and accountability for platform operations

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Strong attention to detail, especially in governance and compliance

• Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions

• Strong incident management and root-cause analysis capabilities

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Junior Data Engineer (Production & Supply Chain)

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Information & Knowledge Architect
jobs.description:
At Llbg, we believe that high-quality information is the foundation of better decisions, efficient collaboration, and successful AI adoption. As our Information & Knowledge Architect, you will define how information is structured, governed, and managed across the organization.

You will create the frameworks, standards, and governance models that transform data and content into trusted business knowledge. Working closely with architects, platform owners, and business stakeholders, you will ensure that information is accessible, reliable, compliant, and ready to power future AI-driven solutions. This is a strategic, hands-on role where architecture, governance, technology, and change management come together.
Function

• You define and own Llbg's information and knowledge architecture, including domain models, business glossaries, taxonomies, metadata standards, and semantic frameworks that create a shared understanding across systems, countries, and teams.

• You establish and drive our information governance framework, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards, classification, retention, and lifecycle management for both structured and unstructured information.

• You lead master data governance by defining business object ownership, stewardship responsibilities, standards, and governance processes together with key stakeholders.

• You define how information is created, tagged, classified, versioned, stored, and retired, ensuring that content remains trusted, compliant, and ready to support AI-driven use cases.

• You collaborate closely with architects and platform owners to design and implement information models within governance and Microsoft 365 platforms.

• You establish the governance principles and guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge, ensuring compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal policies.

• You lead by building. For the first AI Knowledge use cases, you are directly involved in the design and delivery, shaping the content model, retrieval logic, grounding approach, evaluation framework, and adoption journey. By leading these initial implementations, you establish the standards, best practices, and reusable templates that future teams can build upon rather than reinvent

• You engage with business stakeholders across the organization to identify, prioritize, and deliver knowledge management and AI-related initiatives that support Llbg's digital transformation journey.

• You lead and coach the AI Knowledge Engineer while driving adoption, change management, and knowledge stewardship across multiple countries and business domains.

• You hold a Master's degree in Information Science, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a related field.

• You bring 8-12 years of experience combining information governance, data governance, and hands-on technical implementation.

• You have successfully designed and implemented taxonomies, metadata models, semantic structures, or governance frameworks that delivered measurable business value.

• You have experience with master data governance in ERP-driven environments; SAP experience is a strong advantage.

• You have the practical capability to build knowledge AI solutions yourself, from preparing and structuring source content to designing enterprise search and RAG-based experiences.

• You understand the technical and operational work behind successful AI adoption, including metadata, retrieval quality, access controls, testing, user feedback, and long-term ownership

• You are familiar with governance and catalog solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar platforms, and communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.

Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

Profile

• A degree in IT or a first experience/internship in IT support.
• Basic knowledge of Windows environments and Microsoft 365.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent French and a good level of English. Dutch is a plus.
• A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong customer-service mindset.
• Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• Great level of English (fluent speaker)

jobs.occupation: Product Owner – Mobile Applications & Business Analysis
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage the product lifecycle for a suite of mobile modules, serving as the business and functional point of contact.
• Gather and analyze business requirements to translate them into detailed functional specifications.
• Model business processes using BPMN to define as-is and to-be states.
• Coordinate impact analyses regarding legal, security, and technical constraints.
• Collaborate with internal and external technical partners to ensure the successful delivery of new features.
• Drive change management activities, including user documentation, training sessions, and second-line support.
• Maintain regular reporting on product progress and strategic alignment for program leadership.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.
• You possess 3+ years of experience in business process modeling using BPMN.
• You bring 1+ years of experience in change management and end-user support.
• You have 1+ years of experience working within the public sector.
• You're experienced in gathering business requirements and translating them into functional requirements.
• You possess strong communication skills to manage multidisciplinary teams and external suppliers.
• You bring a proactive, autonomous, and solution-oriented mindset.
• You have excellent analytical skills with a focus on product value and user needs.
• You possess an active knowledge of Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with mobile application development lifecycles.

Responsibilities

• Drive the functional build-out of the SAP CDC application and its complex interfaces within the system landscape.
• Identify and translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical implementations.
• Lead hands-on implementation of B2C and B2B Customer Identity & Access Management solutions.
• Collaborate with integration teams to deliver required interfaces between SAP and non-SAP environments.
• Manage organizational workspace settings, including delegated user administration and approval workflows.
• Maintain and optimize screensets, UI builder configurations, and identity query tools.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CDC and CIAM.
• You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CRM.
• You possess expertise in B2B and B2C identity management, including Screensets and UI Builder.
• You have experience working with Identity Query Tool, APIs, and Site creation.
• You're skilled in User Management, Authorizations, and Master Data Management.
• You possess strong analytical skills to translate functional requirements into technical specifications.
• You're an enthusiastic team player with a problem-solving mindset and strong operational practices.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English at a minimum CEFR level C1.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA and SAP CPI integrations.
• Familiarity with GDPR processes within SAP CDC.
• Experience with Adobe marketing platforms and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of ServiceNow and Jira.
• Experience working in a transport or logistics context.

Production worker – early hours
Manpower is excited to help you find the perfect match for your dream job!
 We're looking for an early bird to join our production team in Zele for a fast-growing family business!
 

Jobomschrijving

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.

We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.
You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.
Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!
 Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain .NET applications using C# and .NET Core.
• Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and validate technical analyses.
• Resolve complex technical issues and provide second-level bug support for existing applications.
• Automate testing and integration by implementing pipelines and unit tests to ensure environment stability.
• Collaborate within a SAFe environment alongside cross-functional team members including testers and product owners.
• Prepare and review technical documentation to ensure high software quality and knowledge sharing.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in software development with C# and .NET Core or .NET Framework.
• 3+ years working in Agile, Scrum, or SAFe environments.
• 3+ years of experience with Blazor.
• 3+ years of experience with MS SQL.
• 3+ years of experience with Azure DevOps and NServiceBus.
• 1+ years of experience with WCF and gRPC.
• 1+ years of experience with Azure Cloud and CI/CD pipelines.
• Proactive and solution-oriented with strong analytical skills.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a passive knowledge of English and an elementary understanding of the other national language.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL.

What will you do?  

• Assist our customers with architecture and design of high available, secure and scalable integration solutions. 
• You’ll delve into the creation of an integration reference architecture, integration frameworks and integration strategy. 
• By promoting modularity, scalability and maintainability, you’ll design and develop integration architectures.  
• Cooperate with the customers' project teams to realize sustainable integration solutions.  
• After the implementation phase, you’ll mentor and coach (potential) customers in the Integration methodology and frameworks  
 

Who are we looking for?  

• Experience with one or more middleware technologies and interface technologies and concepts.  
• Already worked with architecture/design modeling languages and have hands-on experience with the design or architectures of integrations, services, API’s, etc.  
• Understand how orchestration and choreography realize business processes and have experience with synchronous and asynchronous integration.  
• Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English  
• Thrives in a hybrid environment, but is also willing to commute to Antwerp, Brussels, or Ghent on a regular basis. 
• Education level minimum Bachelor or equivalent through experience.

The Group Controller will be responsible for the finances of the holding and the consolidation for the analytic Reporting at Group Level. The role includes a quite operational maintenance of the business controlling, with an eye for details and a strong analytical mind, as well as the opportunity to discuss strategic matters and have a direct impact on the results of the company, driving the financial performance of the Group.

Jobomschrijving

The Group Controller plays a role at the center of the group activities and will manage a wide range of responsibilities. This role is transverse with a global vision and the will to have an impact. 

Group consolidation and financial reporting

• Coordinate group-wide budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning across all entities
• Contribute to financial reporting for executive management, Board, and Audit Committee
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making

Monitoring of holding costs

• Coordinate and monitor holding-level costs during budget and forecast cycles
• Consolidate and analyze intercompany cost data
• Ensure correct and consistent application of transfer pricing policies

Continuous improvement of financial processes and tools

• Drive improvements in financial processes, reporting, and tools
• Collaborate with controlling teams to implement best practices
• Support standardization and automation initiatives across finance

The Group Controller presents a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in finance, Business Management, Economics - or equivalent
• Around 4-5 years of experience in Finance (ideally in a controlling position)
• Excellent command of French & English - Dutch is a plus
• Experience with SAP
• An affinity with process management and IT tools
• Solution oriented and Proactive
• Critical mindset
• Excellent communication skills and partnering approach

The Group Controller - Consolidation will have the unique opportunity to enter a well-established, leader in its market company within a dynamic and new Financial Team. It is the opportunity to be part of a real project and to bring direct added value to the function and the Group.

jobs.occupation: Consolidation Officer in a Listed Belgian Company - Brussels
jobs.description:
In the context of transformation in the energy sector and international growth, the company is strengthening its central finance team to support its consolidation and reporting activities at group level. The Consolidation Officer has a global view and global responsibilities over the whole business.

Jobomschrijving

As Consolidation Officer, you directly report to the Manager and work in a team of 3. The consolidation team is stable and has great evolution perspective.

Therefore, keep in mind that the function is open to evolution and growth.

• Perform group consolidation for monthly, quarterly and annual closings.
• Prepare consolidation adjustments and reconcile intercompany transactions.
• Support the preparation of consolidated financial statements and reports.
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making.
• Ensure compliance with group accounting policies and IFRS standards.
• Coordinate with internal teams and support internal and external audits.
• Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and improvement of consolidation processes and tools.

As the function will be central and will also show great perspectives, the profile will have to show a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in Finance / Business Management / Economics - Or equivalent
• At least 2 or 3 years of financial experience (audit is a plus - consolidation experience is a real added value)
• IFRS knowledge / experience is a plus
• Fluent in English, good French and/or Dutch command (written and spoken)
• Proactive and Outgoing: being able to go out of your comfort zone, to take initiative
• Positive and result oriented

Mainly, the right candidate will have had to have at least a first financial experience, and will demonstrate a great ambition, the desire to learn and to evolve.

jobs.employer_name: BIO BASE EUROPE PILOT PLANT VZW
jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Information Management

jobs.occupation: Freelance Project Manager Warehouse - Brownfield Project
jobs.description:
Our client is a rapidly expanding international consumer goods company strengthening its footprint across Central & Eastern Europe. To support this growth, they are launching a new warehouse and transport platform in the Czech Republic that will serve the entire CEE region.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Project Manager Warehouse your responsibilities are:

• Participate in the final tender and negotiation phase to select and contract the warehouse partner in the Czech Republic.
• Define and implement warehouse operating procedures (SOPs) together with the selected 3PL.
• Prepare the dedicated warehouse areas and align operational ways of working with the logistics partner.
• Establish KPI tracking, governance routines, and daily/weekly/monthly performance reviews.

• Monitor warehouse and transport performance, customer service levels, stock accuracy, inbound/outbound activities, and delivery lead times.

• Support business growth by identifying service and logistics optimization opportunities.
• Prepare the operational handover to the future Logistics Manager after the stabilization phase.

• Proven experience managing warehouse setup, 3PL implementation, or logistics transformation projects in an international environment.
• Strong background in warehousing and transport operations.
• Experience running RFP/RFQ processes and negotiating with logistics providers.
• Knowledge of consumer goods, retail fashion, B2B distribution, or e-commerce logistics is a strong advantage.
• Fluent Czech and English are mandatory.

These studies rely on advanced electricity market modelling and simulation tools to assess future electricity demand, generation capacity and overall system adequacy.

As a Data Analyst, you will support the SMA team in developing future energy scenarios and the modelling frameworks used to study Belgium's and Europe's future electricity system.

This is a highly analytical role combining data analysis, programming and energy market expertise. You'll help build and validate datasets, develop analytical tools, improve data processes and support electricity market simulations used to plan the energy transition.

The client is looking for someone who is both an "energy geek" and a "data geek"—someone who enjoys working with data but is equally interested in understanding how the future electricity system will evolve.

• Support the development of future energy scenarios for Belgium and Europe.

• Collect, consolidate and validate large volumes of historical and projected energy data from multiple sources.
 
• Gather projection data from European countries and critically assess whether assumptions are realistic and aligned with defined energy scenarios.
 
• Develop, improve and maintain data collection, data management and scenario-building processes.
 
• Create and maintain datasets used by electricity market modelling tools.
 
• Support model building and perform quality checks on datasets and models.
 
• Assess the impact of modelling assumptions, including demand, renewable production, flexibility and Storage.
 
• Develop and improve tools in Python, R, Excel and VBA.
 
• Create visualisations and analyse simulation outputs using tools such as Power BI, R or QGIS.
 
• Analyse algorithm results, identify trends and support interpretation of simulation outcomes.
 
• Support data engineering activities and interfaces between different tools and systems.
 
• Contribute to improving the team's analytical tools and overall way of working.

What we're looking for

 
• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (medior level).
 
• Strong programming skills in Python or R (experience with both is a plus).
 
• Strong Excel skills.
 
• Experience with data analysis, data mining, data gathering, processing and visualization.
 
• Knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the Belgian and European energy market.
 
• Genuine interest in the energy transition and future energy systems.
 
• Ability to critically challenge data, assumptions and projections rather than simply processing them.
 
• Analytical, proactive and innovative mindset.
 
• Able to work independently as well as collaboratively.
 
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good English.

Technical environment:

 
• Python
 
• R
 
• Excel
 
• VBA
...

You're passionate about the energy transition and motivated to contribute to the planning of tomorrow's electricity system. We're partnered with a large textiles business looking to expand with a new Scrum Master. As AI agents become active participants in the development process - writing, testing, and refactoring code alongside human engineers - the way teams plan, collaborate, and deliver is changing fast.

We are looking for a Scrum Master who thrives in that kind of shift: someone who can hold onto the core of what makes agile teams effective, while being genuinely curious and hands-on about reshaping it for a new way of working.

This isn't a role for someone looking to run ceremonies by the book. It's for someone who wants to help two teams, based in different countries, figure out together what agile looks like when part of the "team" doesn't sleep, doesn't take breaks, and works at a completely different rhythm than the humans around it.
What the role involves

• Facilitating the core Scrum ceremonies - sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives - across two geographically distributed teams, keeping collaboration strong despite the distance

• Rethinking familiar rituals for a new context: when AI agents are completing work continuously rather than in daily human blocks, what does a "daily stand-up" even MEAN? The successful candidate will help the team find out

• Guiding the team through new questions around estimation, velocity, and "done" - questions that don't have settled answers yet, given how differently AI-driven work behaves compared to traditional development

• Supporting developers through a real shift in their day-to-day role: from writing every line of code themselves to defining intent clearly, reviewing and validating what agents produce, and overseeing agentic workflows responsibly

• Building a culture where experimentation is normal and continuous improvement isn't just a retrospective exercise - because the tools and best practices in this space are moving quickly, and the team's process needs to move with them

• Clearing a path for the team by removing blockers, including ones unique to this environment: agent permissions and access, infrastructure limitations, or specification quality issues that trip up automated work

• Working closely with Product Ownership to make sure backlog items are written with enough clarity and testability that both human developers and AI agents can act on them without ambiguity

• Tracking delivery in a way that actually reflects reality - recognising that familiar metrics like story points or lines of code may not tell the full story anymore, and helping the team find better ones

• Building genuine trust and shared practice between the two country-based teams, so that both are working from the same playbook and learning from each other as agentic workflows evolve

• Solid, proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach within a software development environment - enterprise or B2B software experience is a strong plus

• Real, practical familiarity with agentic software development: AI systems that can autonomously plan, write, and test code, not just autocomplete-style tooling

• A clear grasp of how AI-assisted and AI-driven development is reshaping developer workflows, code review, testing, and quality practices

• Genuine comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving change, with a track record of adapting process pragmatically rather than defending a textbook framework for its own sake

• Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills - the human side of this role matters just as much as the technical awareness

• A recognised Scrum Master certification, though the client sees this as a starting point rather than the full picture - this role asks for more than the standard curriculum covers

• Professional fluency in both Dutch and English

 

Nice to have:

• Direct experience working with AI coding agents or AI-augmented development pipelines in a live production setting

• A background in change management, especially leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process

 

The kind of person you are (beyond the CV):

• A fast learner who gets genuinely excited by new technology rather than intimidated by it

• Hands-on and action-oriented - someone who leads by doing, not just directing from the sidelines

• A true team player who helps build a supportive, creative atmosphere for people navigating a lot of change

• Transparent and collaborative, comfortable working openly and respectfully across different teams, cultures, and time zones

• A natural leader - someone who can guide priorities and keep coordination tight across two teams without needing formal authority to do it
