Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. A solid technical understanding matters, but your impact will come through coaching, collaboration, and delivery rather than hands-on implementation.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Keep enough depth in our stack (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services) to contribute to architectural discussions and understand the challenges your team faces. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿.Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including:

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Research/prototype multi-agent collaborative autonomy solutions for unmanned ground systems.
• Support development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy.
• Contribute to the integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles.
• Participate in testing, validation, and demonstration campaigns.
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2
• 
Good programming skills in Python and/or C++

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills: 

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
Personal skills:

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team

• Save and organize all relevant project documentation according to the agreed structure. 

• Ensure that every project proposal follows the department guidelines and contains all required information. 

• Keep your calendar up to date with planned project proposals and other relevant tasks to support smooth collaboration with colleagues. 

• Carry out all assignments with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and clear documentation. 

• Work in a structured and systematic way, aiming for error-free results while continuously improving processes and output. 

• Ensure customers have a positive and professional experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 
 

• You have a strong interest or knowledge in building automation and the standards, protocols and technology used. 

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time without losing overview. 

• You have strong communication skills and can translate technical information into clear explanations for both customers and colleagues. 

• You have a team-oriented mindset and enjoy working closely with sales and technical teams. 

• ·You are customer-focused and proactive in understanding customer needs and providing technically sound solutions. 

• You work accurately and have a strong sense of responsibility for the quality of your work. 

• You are comfortable using standard office software such as Outlook, Excel and Word. 

• You are familiar with digital tools related to daily administrative and project follow-up tasks. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written. 

• You have basic to intermediate knowledge of English, sufficient to understand internal communication and participate in meetings. 

• Fluency in French, both spoken and written, is considered a strong plus.

Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Representative Travel Europe | Hoogstraten | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
For our client in Hoogstraten, we are looking for a Customer Service Representative Travel Europe with immediate permanent employment.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the main point of contact for the customers when it comes to orders, production process follow up, deliveries and introduction of new products. Together with the team of colleagues in the Belgian office and worldwide you ensure the highest level of satisfaction and are able to provide a solution to any problem, either commercial or logistical.

Main Responsibilties: 

 
• End-to-end customer service: from order intake to delivery and aftersales follow-up 
 
• Processing and monitoring sales orders (order entry, production follow-up, delivery tracking) 
 
• Handling complaints and finding solutions in close cooperation with sales 
 
• Daily coordination with internal departments and international stakeholders 
 
• Forecasting, demand management and stock monitoring 
 
• Supporting the sales team with commercial and operational tasks 
 
• Ensuring excellent customer satisfaction at all times

Typical day: 
 
• Morning: order entry and administrative processing 
 
• Afternoon: customer follow-up and complaint handling 

 
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience 
 
• Minimum of 2 years' commercial experience in an international B-to B market environment 
 
• Experience with ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite 
 
• Knowledge of logistics, INCO terms and customs procedures is preferred 
 
• Positive mindset, desire to learn and improve yourself as well as existing processes, attention to detail and problem solving 
 
• Proficient in English and Dutch both oral and written, German or Spanish are an advantage

This company moves over 250 orders a day from  730 suppliers in EAME to over 72 facilities all over the world.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a bachelor’s degree? Are you an analytical thinker with strong communication skills? Can you express yourself clearly, both orally and in writing, in English and Dutch? If so, you could be the Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we’re looking for!

Within the Global Parts Supply (GPS) team, working with suppliers is key. As a GPS team member, you are the vital link between suppliers and customers, managing all supplier communications. The mission is to maintain a healthy supply chain and prevent shortages that could lead to customer back orders. On a daily basis, you liaise with suppliers, drive accountability for their results, and work toward challenging but achievable goals that ensure superior service levels.

As a Logistics Planning Analyst, you are responsible to establish solid business relationships with a set of defined suppliers: 

• Focus on timely and quality deliveries to the distribution center, ensuring parts are available for the end customer.
• Educate and hold suppliers accountable to achieve challenging business results.
• Value teamwork and collaborate with key partners such as transportation, procurement, and engineering as needed.
• To be successful, you will need to develop and master a thorough understanding of our supply chain processes and systems.
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Monitor schedules to ensure punctual and efficient shipments with suppliers.
• Track supplier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
• Maintain strong communication and positive relationships with both internal divisions and external suppliers.
• Evaluate and challenge supplier results based on the supplier performance standard.
• Analyze and correct data irregularities.
• Provide thorough support on high priority back orders.

The Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we are looking for has the following skills:

• Minimum Master’s degree with a strong link to Supply Chain, Logistics Management, Production, and Logistics or Transport.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Analytical mindset.
• Fluent written and oral skills in English and Dutch are required, French or German is a plus.
• Motivated to work in a target focused area.
• Self-motivated and committed.
• Strong interpersonal skills.

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in the rotating shift (6h-14h and 14h-22h).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main tasks as a Maintenance Technician:

• Ensure that the automated systems are maintained and repaired if necessary

• Maintenance and repair of lift trucks

• Perform electrical and mechanical maintenance work on all kinds of installations

• Maintain the order pickers, reach trucks and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technican we are looking for has the following qualities:

• Has an engineering background

• Can work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)

• Is hands-on and dynamic

• Is precise and result-oriented

• Take initiative and responsibility

• Is a team player, but can also work independently

• Has preferably experience with welding

• Good command of English. Dutch is a plus.

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

Robert Half is collaborating with a leading global player in the high‑tech manufacturing industry to recruit a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x).

Our client, an international organization active in advanced industrial technology, develops innovative solutions used in sectors such as energy‑efficient glass, consumer electronics, solar applications and industrial machinery. With production sites in the US, Europe and Asia, the company employs appr. 300 FTE's and operates in a fast‑growing, technology‑driven market.

Position

As a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x), you provide high‑quality financial insights to support strategic decisions across the group. You work closely with leadership teams in different regions and functions, contributing to stronger cost control, profitability analysis and data-driven planning.

This is a key function for an experienced finance professional who enjoys combining analytical depth with a strong business partnering mindset.

From out your role you will interact with the Group Controller and CFO.

Your responsibilities include:

• Managing and improving cost accounting across multiple sites, ensuring accurate standard costing and analyzing manufacturing structures.
• Providing insight into margins and product profitability, including variance analysis and margin reviews.
• Delivering monthly performance analyses across business units: actuals, budget, forecast, prior‑year comparisons.
• Highlighting trends, risks and opportunities, providing clear insights for management.
• Conducting analyses on pricing, capacity, product mix and working capital to support strategic decision-making.
• Developing dashboards, KPIs and Power BI reports to harmonize reporting across sites.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting and long‑range planning, ensuring inputs align with strategic assumptions.
• Contributing to improvement projects such as M&A analyses, transfer pricing, sourcing optimization and cost accounting enhancements.
 

Your profile

• A bachelor's or master's degree in finance.
• At least 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, controlling or a similar finance function, ideally in an international manufacturing or engineering environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
• Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems and experience building dashboards in Power BI (must).
• The ability to balance operational detail with a strategic helicopter view.
• Excellent planning and organizational skills, especially in a fast‑moving context.
• A plus: experience with consolidation systems or IFRS.
• We are looking for an English proficient professional. Dutch is not required.
• Willingness to travel internationally maximum 2 weeks each quarter.

Your first step into support. A hands-on opportunity to build real-worldnetworking expertise, even if you’re at the beginning of your career.

Our partner is a fast-growing technology company operating in theconnectivity and managed network servicesspace. As their activities continue to expand, they are looking for aSupport Engineerto join their technical team. 

 

This is more than a traditional support role: it’s a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset who wants todevelop a career in networking, gain practical experience with different technologies, and progressively specialize in areas such asVPN, WAN, routing and SD-WAN.
Support Engineer - Your day to day
• Provide1st & 2nd line technical supportto customers via phone and ticketing systems.
• Configure and preparenetwork equipment and routersfor new deployments.
• Monitor network environments and proactively identify and resolveconnectivity issues.
• Manageequipment inventoryand ensure accurate tracking of technical assets.
• Participate in anon-call rotationto support customers and maintain high service availability.
• Supporton-site installationsfor new deployments across different environments and locations.
Support Engineer - More about you
• Some practical knowledge ofnetworking fundamentals, such as VLANs, VPNs, WAN/LAN, IP routing or basic firewall configuration.
• You may bejunior or at the start of your career— motivation and technical curiosity are more important than extensive experience.
• A strong interest inNetworking & Connectivity, with the ambition to develop deeper expertise in technologies such as SD-WAN and SDN.
• Acustomer-oriented mindsetand a genuine commitment to delivering a high-quality support experience.
• Strong communication skills inDutch and English; a good level of French is a plus.
• A proactive, hands-on personality with a genuineappetite for learning and solving technical challenges.

Responsibilities

• Oversee the progress of applications within the portfolio and report findings to project leadership.
• Challenge technical specifications and functional choices to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
• Maintain high code quality through rigorous reviews and established development guidelines.
• Lead and coach multiple development teams to coordinate sprint activities and resolve technical issues.
• Design and communicate a clear vision for the target architecture using industry-standard modeling.
• Organize collaborative technical sessions and workshops with developers and other architects.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in .NET architecture, microservices, and core development patterns.
• You bring 8+ years of expertise in architectural design using UML and Archimate.
• You possess 5+ years of experience in modern UI delivery with Blazor and Microfrontends.
• You're experienced with Azure cloud resources and Kubernetes components such as pods, ingress, and networking.
• You bring 3+ years of knowledge in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Helm deployments.
• You have experience with testing methodologies including unit tests, feature tests, and mocking.
• You're proactive, analytical, and possess strong communication and coaching skills.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of German, French, or Dutch.

Our client, an international company located in the Ghent region, is looking for a Sourcing Analyst to expand the Procurement Team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sourcing Analyst you will be responsible for following domains:Category Management

• Address all areas of category management including category business plans, global market and pricing analysis, and procurement support.
• Contribute to the development of the company's strategic category objectives and goals.
• Assist in the development of global category strategies with defined plans for cost savings, risk assessment and mitigation, and service level agreements.
• Support the CM in developing and executing category negotiation strategies with suppliers, including specific targets for pricing, service, quality, intellectual property, tool ownership, exclusivity, and inventory.
• Monitor current category market conditions, technology roadmaps, and identify supply/demand challenges and opportunities.
• Develop subject matter expertise in assigned commodities through external research, benchmarking, and analysis of cost drivers and life cycle costs. Provide market intelligence and category price trends.

Sourcing Management

• Utilise the strategic sourcing process to manage assigned commodities and finished products across multiple locations and subsidiaries
• Identify all stakeholders for each major category and form cross-functional teams to define and implement strategies that reduce cost, improve quality, and strengthen the competitive position
• Provide rigorous analysis of spend data and market trends to prioritise and launch sourcing initiatives within designated categories
• Analyse current spend and evaluate current suppliers; consolidate spend across multiple manufacturing locations to create leverage
• Identify new high-potential suppliers
You work together with your (international) procurement team and will report to the Sourcing Manager.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field
• Minimum proven first solid professional experience in (strategic) sourcing, category management, or an equivalent procurement function
• Experience in a multinational or European industrial environment is a strong asset
• Demonstrated knowledge of strategic sourcing tools and processes in a global, multi-site manufacturing context
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities using contemporary tools and methods (Excel, ERP/procurement systems, spend analytics platforms)
• Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to articulate complex topics clearly at all organisational levels
• Proficiency in English is required
• Willingness to travel

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.

Your Role as Technical Superintendent

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels	
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections	
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week)	
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships	
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation)	
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades	
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS)	
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies	
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments

Your Profile:
	
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering	
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping)	
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement)	
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations	
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation	
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations	
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality	
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew	
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

PROJECT

You work within the department of Communication Information Systems and Sensors (CISS) of the Faculty Polytechnics of the RMA. You conduct technical research support activities on multiple research projects entitled `Advanced SATCOM L1/L2 Threat and Resilience Assessment (ASTRA)', Wearable Adaptive Antenna-Radio Systems for Reliable Tactical Communications (WARCOM)' and `Adaptive Laser Countermeasures Against Advanced IR-guided Threats' (ALCAAT).

 

ASTRA aims at identifying vulnerabilities in modern satellite communication systems at physical and data link layer level and assessing their resilience through the design and implementation of passive and active RF attacks in a controlled laboratory environment. 

 

WARCOM focuses on the design, fabrication, integration and evaluation of adaptive wearable antenna systems for tactical communications, ensuring compatibility with current and future tactical radios. The project includes electromagnetic simulations, laboratory RF measurements and field testing under realistic operational conditions. 

 

ALCAAT aims to develop adaptive laser-based countermeasures that react quickly to modern infrared (IR) threats. It will evaluate how atmospheric conditions affect their effectiveness against imaging seekers through laboratory and field trials. The goal is to advance the Technology Readiness Level (TRL) from 3 to 5 by transitioning from controlled environments to outdoor testing.

 

Within these projects, you support researchers and PhD candidates by preparing and maintaining experimental setups, managing laboratory infrastructure, and assisting in measurement campaigns and integration activities. 

 

MAIN TASKS

• Preparation, installation and maintenance of RF, Telecommunications, and (opto-)electronics laboratory setups including Software Defined Radio platforms, SATCOM terminals, antennas, spectrum analyzers and related equipment. 
• Support in the execution of laboratory measurements and field trials. 
• Technical integration of radio systems, embedded platforms and measurement equipment.
• Management of equipment inventory, calibration follow-up and safety procedures. 
• Preparation and follow up of purchases of technical and test equipment in accordance with procurement procedures.
• Occasional support during demonstrations and interactions with Defense stakeholders and industrial partners. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required: (Professional) Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electromechanics or equivalent technical field. 

This position is open for experienced profiles (ideally 3 years of experience minimum) or senior profiles (ideally 8 years of experience minimum).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills :

• Practical experience with RF measurement equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators or network analyzers
• Basic knowledge of radio frequency systems and antennas
• Experience in laboratory work and technical integration of electronic systems
• Ability to read technical datasheets and schematics
¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills : 

• Experience with Software Defined Radio platforms
• Experience with SATCOM equipment
• Experience with opto-electronics equipment
• Knowledge of basic scripting or programming for measurement automation
• Experience with field measurements or outdoor test campaigns
Personal skills :

• You think in an innovative and creative way.
• You communicate technical information in a clear, concise and precise manner.
• You are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You behave in a respectful way toward the others, their ideas and opinions as well as toward procedures and instructions.
• You commit yourself in your job by giving the best of your aptitudes in striving toward the highest quality standards and persevere when needed.
Other skills:

• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English.
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The technician may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent to the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• Only applicants with a nationality of a country that is both part of NATO and the EU will be eligible.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 1 September 2026, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding projects, which is guaranteed until 30 April 2030. There is a high chance for the projects to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding. 
• Wage scale: wage scale B1 (holder of a professional bachelor's degree or equivalent with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) 
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

jobs.occupation: Researcher in Weapon Systems and Ballistics (RAPTOR) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Department of Weapon Systems and Ballistics (ABAL) of the Royal Military Academy, and in close collaboration with the industrial and academic partners of the consortium. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled 'RAPTOR'.

RAPTOR addresses the growing defence need created by the proliferation of drones that threaten civil and military security. The project aims to facilitate and accelerate the development of innovative weapon systems, specifically designed to neutralise these mobile air targets efficiently by integrating artificial intelligence in fire control algorithms and target designation. Four objectives structure the work: reducing the time-to-market, reducing the cost, remaining at the state of the art, and guaranteeing the performance of the weapon systems studied.

The incumbent will contribute to weapon system performance studies and test campaigns, provide fragmentation modelling that feeds the multi-source data fusion activities, characterise representative C-UAS operational scenarios drawn from the open literature, analyse the vulnerability and the survivability of drone targets, define the fragment patterns that maximise terminal effects, quantify aerodynamic coefficients, study collateral damage risk and contribute to the preparation, execution and exploitation of the experimental firing campaigns.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Model representative C-UAS operational scenarios on the basis of concrete cases available in the open literature, with a focus on the neutralisation phase.
• Analyse the vulnerability and the survivability of drone targets component by component, including the determination of critical thresholds and of the number of impacts required to reach a defined level of neutralisation.
• Perform fragmentation simulations with dedicated software and calibrate the analytical models on experimental results, in order to define the fragment patterns that maximise terminal effects.
• Contribute to the quantification of the aerodynamic coefficients used by the Point Mass model for fragmentation and by the 6DOF model for the ballistic trajectory.
• Quantify collateral damage and the associated risk probability, so that the choice of the engagement approach can be balanced against ballistic performance.
• Contribute to the elaboration of the test application document, participate in the firing campaigns and in the data acquisition, and support the post-processing and the writing of the test reports.
• Validate the simulations by reproducing the representative scenarios on the test range and by comparing simulated and experimental survivability.
• Contribute to technical reports, to the deliverables towards the funding authority, and to scientific publications and conferences. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required: Master's degree in Engineering (Applied Sciences, Engineering Sciences), preferably in mechanical, aerospace, electromechanical or a closely related discipline.

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) and experienced profiles (ideally 3 years of experience minimum).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills

• Academic experience (projects, master's thesis) or professional experience in the numerical modelling and simulation of mechanical, aerodynamic or ballistic problems.
• Academic or professional experience in experimental test campaigns and data acquisition.
• Programming skills.
• 
Proficiency in the production of technical and/or scientific documents.

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills 

• Training or experience in ballistics, weapon systems or fragmentation modelling.
• Training or experience with drones, C-UAS systems or weapon systems performance.
• Training or experience with Split-X and/or Python.
• Training or experience in artificial intelligence.
Personal skills

• You conduct scientific research in an independent and upright way within a multidisciplinary environment.
• You communicate your results in a clear, concise and precise manner.
• You are involved, innovative and result oriented.
• You solve problems autonomously, take initiative and find alternatives or solutions.
• You will be working very closely together with the partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral / written).
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of French (oral / written).
• Minimum knowledge of Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
• Experience in scientific literature review and scientific writing is an added value.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• Only applicants with a nationality of a country that is both part of NATO and the EU will be eligible.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.
 
 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 01/11/2026, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Wage scale: Salary scale: wage scale NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) 
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do:

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges.

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards.

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications.

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development.

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools.

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies.

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•

•

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

• Analyse business processes across People & Culture, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and related people functions to identify opportunities for AI adoption and process optimisation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Previous exposure to AI tools (e.g. Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Power Platform, automation platforms, or similar technologies) is an asset.

As Chief Project Officer, you will lead our complete project portfolio in the Benelux and across Europe. You will manage three direct reports and take responsibility for a multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees across BIM, work preparation, project management, site management, automation and part of the validation activities. You will create the structure, standards and leadership needed to support continued growth.

You will get to know our customers, markets and ADAPTUS platform (our modular platform for standardised, scalable cleanroom solutions) inside out.

Your responsibilities include:

•Taking final responsibility for projects from design and execution through to delivery

•Leading, coaching and developing three direct reports and the wider multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees

•Acting as a technical sparring partner on complex HVAC and cleanroom challenges

•Safeguarding margins, planning, quality and performance across the project portfolio

•Building and managing reliable subcontractor networks throughout Europe

•Driving standardisation and process optimisation through the ADAPTUS platform

•Translating our European ambitions into a scalable project organisation
 

Once you have demonstrated clear leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence, your responsibilities will expand to Chief Operating Officer.

As COO, you will take responsibility for a broader operational organisation of approximately 22 employees on the ABN payroll, complemented by an extensive network of subcontractors responsible for project execution. Your scope will include projects and service, including maintenance, validation and operational customer support. You will develop service into a profitable activity within our Cleanroom-as-a-Service strategy and connect projects and service into one seamless customer lifecycle.

The transition to Chief Operating Officer is based on demonstrated leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence. For the right candidate, this progression is expected within approximately six to eighteen months.

You combine strong leadership skills with genuine technical depth.

HVAC holds no secrets for you. You understand air handling, pressure cascades, cooling loads and control technology well enough to challenge BIM specialists, work preparation teams, project managers, site managers, automation experts, validation specialists and subcontractors on content.

You also bring:

•At least ten years of experience in complex technical projects at customer sites

•Several years of experience in a senior leadership role

•Experience managing managers and multidisciplinary technical teams, rather than only operational teams

•Proven greenfield experience in another European country

•Hands-on experience sourcing, contracting and managing local subcontractors abroad

•A technical master’s degree or equivalent experience

•Fluency in Dutch and English; French or German is an advantage

•A structural willingness to travel across Europe

•An entrepreneurial, hands-on and highly result-driven mindset
 

Experience in cleanrooms, pharmaceuticals, biotech, laboratories, food production or high-tech environments is a strong asset.

Above all, you are a builder. You do not wait for the perfect structure — you create it.

jobs.description:
Introduction
 

At Ekwip, our goal is simple: 
help local retail thrive internationally.
 

A sports shop in Namur, a bookshop in Ghent or a pet store in Rotterdam may have 
20–40% of its inventory sitting unsold, tying up cash and losing value. Ekwip takes care of this stock from end to end and sells it online across Europe through major marketplaces.
 

Retailers keep their store, identity and existing operations without having to become e-commerce experts.
 

The model is proven: steady monthly growth, no customer churn since launch and partnerships underway with major distributors. After a strong start in French-speaking Belgium, Ekwip is now expanding into Flanders and the Netherlands.
 

The pitch takes 90 seconds and the sales cycle is measured in days, not quarters. With 
more than 150,000 independent retailers across Europe, the opportunity is to sign hundreds of customers every year.
 

About the Role
 

You will lead 
business development from A to Z, working directly with Ekwip’s three co-founders.
 

Independent and specialised retailers
 
 

• Identify and target retailers in sports, fashion, footwear, pet care, home, toys and books 

• Build your own pipeline through cold calling, store visits, networking and trade fairs 

• Manage qualification, negotiation and closing 

• Organise your prospecting by region with a strong focus on efficiency and results  

Distributors and industrial wholesalers
 
 

• Identify the most relevant partners 

• Define the right approach and activate new opportunities 

• Lead negotiations and close strategic agreements 

• Develop partnerships where 
one agreement can unlock an entire network of stores  

Market insights and performance
 
 

• Act as Ekwip’s eyes and ears in the market 

• Share customer needs, recurring objections and local market practices 

• Feed insights directly into the product roadmap 

• Continuously manage your pipeline and performance  

Growth opportunities
 

Ekwip’s medium-term ambition is to build a commercial team in each country, with Business Developers and Account Managers.
 

You will be the first building block of this structure. 
Strong performance can lead to a management role, where you will recruit, train and lead your own local sales team.
 

Your Profile
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field 

• Fluent Dutch is essential, as this is the main market to develop; French and English are needed 

• A successful first experience in B2B sales, with proven results 

• Valid driving licence  

What we are looking for
 
 

• A true hunter mindset: you are comfortable with cold outreach and know how to build a pipeline from scratch 

• Strong autonomy: you manage your territory like your own business 

• Genuine curiosity for retail: you listen as much as you sell 

• A structured and methodical approach to pipeline management 

• The motivation to build in a fast-paced, demanding and pragmatic environment 

• Experience in retail, SaaS or marketplaces is a strong advantage

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware compute systems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

We are looking for a Virtual Platform R&D Engineer to develop, enable, and maintain our baseline platform across functional models, RTL prototyping, and simulation environments. This role sits at the intersection of compute architecture, system software, and system modeling. 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Develop and maintain virtual platforms across both simulated, and hardware-prototyping environments. 

• Support workload mapping and enable functional models bring-up on various execution platforms such as: QEMU, gem5, RTL, FGPA. 

• Contribute to performance and functional validation across abstraction levels (ISA → RTL → FPGA). 

• Build system models that represent novel compute architectures, while balancing accuracy, execution speed, and ease of use. 

• Evaluate new architectural features, translating architectural concepts into executable platforms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring students when necessary.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant domains with hands-on compute architecture systems.   

• You are passionate about computer architecture and system-level design, with a solid understanding of modern compute and memory systems, and SoC components.  

• You have a strong background in embedded systems, including toolchains (GCC/LLVM), RTOS (e.g., Zephyr), and low-level debugging.  

• You are proficient in C/C++, in bash and Python scripting.  

• You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys bringing systems to life.  

• You have experience in RISC-V-based system architecture.   

• You are open-minded, and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs.   

• You are a team player, as you will be part of a dynamic and distributed team.  

• You are fluent in English and you have strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across a multicultural team.

jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Interoperability and Architecture Design for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT 

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿. Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including: 

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems 
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms 
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team 
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe. 

 

MAIN TASKS 

 

• Lead development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy. 
• Leading the planning and execution of international demonstration campaigns. 
• Support in testing and validation of the multi-agent framework. 
• Contribute to integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles. 
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports.  
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields 

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience. 

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills: 

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English 
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2 
• Good programming skills in Python and/or C++ 
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:  

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI 
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics 
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design 
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards 
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations 
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers. 
Personal skills: 

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team 
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.

CONTRACT

A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:

 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

• Experience with test data management

• Knowledge of French or Dutch is an asset

Grow the market. Build the right partnerships. Strengthen the Manutti brand.

Manutti is a Belgian luxury outdoor furniture brand with strong international ambitions.

To accelerate our growth in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, we are looking for an experienced sales professional with a strong background in premium outdoor furniture and luxury design, a deep understanding of dealer networks and a genuine drive to develop markets through strong personal relationships.

This is a highly international role. You will spend a significant amount of time in your target markets, close to customers, prospects and opportunities, while remaining strongly connected to the Manutti team through regular presence at our headquarters in Belgium.

As External Sales Manager DACH & UK, you take commercial ownership of your markets.

You will:

• 
Grow and strengthen our network of premium dealers

• 
Identify and onboard new high-potential partners

• 
Develop existing accounts and drive sustainable growth

• 
Increase showroom visibility, product presence and sell-through

• 
Identify opportunities within retail and project business

• 
Build strong relationships with dealers, architects, designers and key partners

• 
Represent Manutti at customer meetings, events and international fairs

• 
Stay close to the market and turn opportunities into concrete results

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a commercially driven relationship builder with the instinct of a hunter and the discipline of a strong account manager.

You bring:

• 
Solid international B2B sales experience

• 
Proven experience in premium outdoor furniture, luxury furniture or high-end design

• 
Strong experience with dealer and distribution networks

• 
A track record in both new business and key account development

• 
A strong affinity with luxury, architecture and design

• 
An autonomous, entrepreneurial and result-driven mindset

• 
The flexibility and willingness to travel extensively

Fluent German and English are essential.

Additional languages are a strong asset.

ViaMotive is not a traditional company. As a multi-brand dealer for brands such as Higer, Temsa and EVM, we provide smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

With the growing number of electric buses, our workshop is changing too. That's why we're looking for a skilled 
Diagnostic Bus Technician to join our team.

What if you could lead the team that transforms breakthrough chip architectures into real silicon?

At imec, you will manage a multidisciplinary group developing advanced compute platforms and silicon prototypes that explore the future of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (HPC) and automotive systems. Your work will help define how next-generation chips are designed, integrated and manufactured beyond today's conventional system-on-chip approaches.

You will combine scientific leadership, people management and technology vision in one of the world's leading semiconductor research environments.

 

What you will do
 

As R&D Group Manager, you will lead a team of architects and engineers developing advanced compute systems from concept to silicon validation.

You will:
 
 

• Lead a team of chip architects, silicon designers and R&D engineers. 

• Translate novel computing concepts into manufacturable silicon demonstrators. 

• Drive the development of next-generation compute platforms based on RISC-V and chiplet-based architectures. 

• Guide projects across the complete development cycle, from architectural exploration to prototype fabrication. 

• Enable close collaboration between architecture, software, design technology and silicon implementation experts. 

• Build a high-performing team by coaching, mentoring and developing researchers and engineers. 

• Help shape imec's vision for future 3D-integrated computing systems.  

Who you are
 

You combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership.

You bring:

Must-have
 
 

• 10+ years of experience in digital system architecture and semiconductor design. 

• Solid understanding of advanced chip and compute-system development. 

• Experience with RISC-V or similar processor architectures. 

• Previous experience leading engineers, researchers or technical experts. 

• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.  

Nice-to-have
 
 

• Experience with chiplet-based architectures and die-to-die interconnect technologies. 

• Knowledge of hardware modelling and hardware generation methodologies. 

• Experience with advanced verification methodologies and design automation flows.
