jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

AND IN DETAIL

• You will design and validate solutions for development frameworks, platforms, and toolchains, enabling Dev Engineers to build and deploy scalable cloud-native applications.
• You will produce and maintain high-quality architecture documentation—including blueprints, solution architectures, and reference architectures—to ensure alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and business requirements.
• You will support other architects and development teams by providing expert guidance on scalable, resilient design patterns and cloud-native best practices.
• You will demystify complex technical concepts (e.g., service mesh, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation) to ensure solutions are secure, performant, and developer friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Cloud-Native Development: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-native applications (microservices, containers) with a focus on scalability, resilience, and observability.
• Kubernetes & OpenShift: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift 
• IBM Cloud Platform: Proficiency in IBM Cloud services (e.g., Openshift and other native IBM Cloud services like EventStream, COS,…)
• Toolchain & Automation: Strong background in DevOps toolchains (CI/CD pipelines, GitOps) and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, scripting) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
• Java Frameworks: Experience with modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot) and their integration with cloud-native ecosystems.
• Developer Experience (DevEx): Ability to design and improve developer tools, platforms, and workflows to enhance productivity, reduce friction, and foster adoption of cloud-native practices.
• You are fluent in English (oral and written). Basic knowledge of Dutch or French is an asset.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Build the backbone of our digital future as a Web Infrastructure Architect in our Agile Production Services (APS) tribe. Based in Brussels (HQ), you’ll design, secure, and optimize the high-performance web infrastructure that powers our business, working alongside a diverse, skilled team to push boundaries in scalability, security, and cloud innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise-grade web solutions, this is where your expertise will make an impact.

 

AND IN DETAIL

You won’t just maintain systems, you’ll engineer resilience, performance, and security into every layer of our web infrastructure. 
Here’s how:

Design with precision

• Craft Detailed Technical Designs (DTDs) that turn business needs into scalable, future-proof architectures.
• Define reference architectures to standardize how we build, deploy, and secure web applications.
Solve deep technical problems

• Debug complex incidents using APM tools, logs, and traces, finding root causes and fixing them for good.
• Optimize performance by analyzing application flows, bottlenecks, and resource usage (think: WebSphere tuning, Kubernetes scaling, TLS handshakes).
Secure and modernize

• Harden our web hosting (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS) and security layers (F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, oAuth2, HSM).
• Lead cloud migration and optimization (IaaS/PaaS) while keeping costs and risks in check.
• Collaborate and influence
• Work closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to ensure designs are practical, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Mentor and guide, your expertise will help raise the bar for the entire team.
• Keep us ahead of the curve
• Monitor, measure, and improve, proactively spotting risks and opportunities in our web infrastructure.
• Drive cost-efficiency initiatives, from right-sizing resources to decommissioning legacy systems.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes web infrastructure with the skills to back it up.

 

Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)

• 5+ years in infrastructure architecture, with hands-on experience in:
• Web Application Hosting: WebSphere, Kubernetes, IIS, Tomcat
• Web Security: F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, HSM, oAuth2, TLS
• Cloud Environments: IaaS/PaaS (design, migration, optimization)
• Performance troubleshooting: APM tools, logging, tracing, capacity planning
• Incident analysis: Root-cause investigation for web infrastructure issues
 

How You Work

• Analytical and data-driven: You don’t guess, you measure, analyze, and optimize.
• Collaborative: You thrive in cross-functional teams (Security, DevOps, Development) and can explain complex tech simply.
• Proactive and pragmatic: You spot problems before they happen and solve them efficiently.
 

Nice-to-Haves

• Languages: Fluent in English (mandatory); French/Dutch is a plus.
• Education/Certs: Master’s degree (or equivalent experience). TOGAF, ITIL, or Agile certifications are a bonus.
 

Soft Skills

• A team player who’s autonomous, adaptable, and ready to tackle challenges in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

• Define test objectives and E2E strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
• Coordinate functional, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across different project phases.
• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to communicate test progress, risks, and outcomes.

• Manage defect tracking and risk mitigation strategies to ensure timely project delivery and quality standards.
• Provide actionable quality reports and insights to support go/no-go decisions based on readiness and trends.

Requirements

• Proactive, autonomous, and result-driven approach.
• You are fluent in English with French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to contribute to internal quality assurance knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Position overview:
 

 
 

You manage the plant’s environmental, health and safety (EHS), fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. You also provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, sustainability issues, and proactively management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. Coordinate EHS activity, including EHS management systems (ISO and ASI) (certified where applicable). Accountable for rolling out Ball EHS BOE (Ball Operational Excellence) and sustainability initiatives.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

 
 
 

• Develop and implement BBS and proactive reporting and engagement initiatives such as near miss, hazard and/or good catch to promote safe behaviours and develop a positive safety culture. 

• Identify and ensure compliance with EHS compliance obligations (e.g. laws, regulations, permits, licences etc) and other stakeholder requirements (e.g. FSPP insurance). 

• Ensure plant management and workers are aware of, take ownership and deliver on their respective EHS accountabilities and responsibilities, including deputies to cover absences. Escalate issues promptly to the plant manager and Regional EHS. 

• Implement and maintain hazard identification and risk assessment programme that reflects hazards during normal, abnormal and emergency conditions and apply the hierarchy of control. Incorporates the Ball BOE, LiFE and hazard mapping into risk management programmes. 

• Identify and assess environment aspects and manage significant impacts under normal, abnormal and emergency conditions including emissions to air, waste, water, wastewater, energy and VOCs. Implement programs to manage significant impacts such as waste minimisation management strategy, pollution prevention, ecological issues. Manage environmental protection infrastructure. 

• Manage the timely reporting, recording, investigation and identification of root causes of EHS incidents and complaints along with oversight of corrective actions including Global reporting via Enablon and Alerts. 

• Work with functional department leaders to develop and implement EHS programmes, requirements, rules, procedures, systems to manage EHS risk and meet all EHS requirements and drive continuous improvement. 

• Establish and implement robust communication and consultation channels to raise awareness, drive engagement, provide information on EHS issues including oversight of the EHS committee and liaison with Safety Representatives. 

• Implement and maintain integrated EHS management systems (and where applicable maintain certification to ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BRC, food safety standards and integrated with ISO 9001) including oversight of external and internal audits, FSPP surveys and management reviews. Follows up on corrective actions. 

• Implement occupational / industrial hygiene, occupational health and well-being programmes in accordance with identified risks and legal requirements in consultation with HR and external providers. 

• Act as primary liaison with regulatory authorities and other external stakeholders (for example insurers, auditors) and internal stakeholders (Regional and Global EHS, Group Insurance, Group Security) and ensure their requirements and reporting are dealt with efficiently. 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Min. 5 years of EHS experience, with 3 years management in a similar industry, with proactive shopfloor engagement and comprehensive knowledge of EHS risks and issues. 

• Relevant EHS qualification to a high level (minimum diploma or local equivalent); alternatively engineering qualification with relevant experience of at least 3 years in an EHS managerial role in manufacturing, heavy engineering or construction. 

• Comprehensive knowledge of EHS legislative requirements. 

• Working knowledge of implementing behaviour-based safety programmes. 

• Managing fire safety and property protection insurance risks. 

• Excellent computer skills (Proficient in MS Office Suite). 

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Dutch.

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Proactive & Resilient: You take ownership, adapt quickly, and deliver under pressure.
• Strict on Execution: You track progress meticulously and ensure no detail is overlooked
• Team Player in a Multicultural Setting: You collaborate smoothly with diverse, high-performing teams.

As a Senior Information Security Officer, you are the strategic leader who defines, drives and strengthens Luminus’ cybersecurity vision across the entire organization. You ensure that our IT, OT, business operations, subsidiaries and affiliates are protected against evolving cyber threats while supporting our mission to deliver reliable and secure energy services to millions of customers.

What you'll do

• You define and implement a company-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with Luminus’ business objectives, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.

• You develop and maintain security policies, standards and governance frameworks, and ensure their effective adoption across the organization, subsidiaries and affiliates.
• Build and manage the cybersecurity roadmap, driving initiatives that strengthen resilience, compliance and operational efficiency while building on the strong foundations already in place.
• You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.
• Represent Luminus towards regulators, authorities, auditors and external partners, while chairing the Information Security Forum and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

• You have at least 8 years of experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
• Extensive expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security technologies, regulatory compliance and the ability to translate security requirements into business value.
• You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
• Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
• You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.

Mandatory skills:

Master's degree or engineering degree (BAC +5) in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecom, Automation, Electricity, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a similar technical field is mandatory.

Experience & technical background

• Solid experience in development for complex systems

• Experience in technical leadership or coordination roles
• Fluent in English and French

your responsibilities

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

We're on the lookout for a 
Mid-Level AI Systems Engineer who bridges AI engineering and MLOps. Someone who loves getting hands-on with LLMs, agents, and RAG pipelines, and who cares just as much about what happens once a model reaches production as about building it in the first place. In this role, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems, with a strong focus on generative AI, LLM-based applications, and reliable machine learning operations. In practice your time is split roughly between 60-70% AI Engineering and 30-40% MLOps.
 

In this role you sit at the intersection of engineering and operations, working across teams and disciplines. You'll report to the Head of ML at Sagacify and collaborate with the wider Sagacify and Craftzing delivery organisation. A role that can naturally grow towards a Team Lead position over time.
 

What you'll do :
 

AI Engineering (60-70%)
 
 

• Orchestrate AI system components: LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers, and user interfaces 

• Develop autonomous agents and conversational systems that can plan actions and interact with external tools or APIs 

• Build and optimise RAG pipelines connecting enterprise data sources to LLMs for grounded, contextualised, reliable answers 

• Evaluate system quality through generative AI metrics, coherence tests, and production monitoring (latency, API costs, bias) 

• Deploy and scale solutions with strong attention to latency, security, reliability and cost efficiency 

• Keep an eye on the ecosystem for new models, frameworks and techniques, including open-source tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, etc. 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality, reduce hallucinations, and manage conversational state effectively  

MLOps (30-40%)
 
 

• Build and maintain automation for model deployment, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

• Continuously monitor model performance in production, including drift detection and quality metric tracking 

• Manage updates of libraries, models, and related dependencies in production environments 

• Ensure versioning, reproducibility and safe rollout of models and AI services 

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery 

• Stay current with the latest MLOps practices, tools and platform components  

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

 

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, attention mechanisms, generation parameters and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and algorithmic creativity 

• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You bring rigour, responsiveness and a good incident-handling mindset 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English and French, or at least the first two languages  

Don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box, what matters most is the right mindset and a drive to learn. If you think we’re a match, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.

• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Thirty countries. Sixty legal entities. A BPO partner in India. Monthly closes under pressure and an ERP migration running straight through live operations. You've been there, and you know exactly how to bring structure, calm and quality to an environment that never stops moving.

 

We're looking for an AP Manager to lead the European AP hub of an international market leader in medical products, based in Leuven. This is a Global Business Services environment with teams spanning Belgium, the UK and India, an active finance transformation programme and products that make a genuine difference in healthcare every single day.

 

 

 

 

 

The Role

As AP Manager, you hold full ownership of the Accounts Payable function and serve as the key link between finance and international business stakeholders. From the European hub in Leuven, you oversee AP operations across Belgium, the United Kingdom and India, working closely with teams distributed around the world.

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Full AP cycle for European countries: receipt, review, processing and approval of invoices in line with group policy
• Three-way matching, discrepancy follow-up and escalation where required
• Preparation and execution of payment runs across multiple methods (EFT, Wire, ACH, DD, SEPA B2B/B2C)
• Vendor reconciliations, AP subledger alignment with the GL and management of intercompany balances
• Monthly and year-end close activities: accruals, prepayments, open POs and AP adjustments
• Compliance oversight: VAT, Intrastat, SOX requirements, internal controls and segregation of duties
• Building and monitoring KPIs and AP reporting: ageing, vendor spend, payment forecasts and accrual summaries
• Supporting audit processes: providing documentation, explaining reconciliations and implementing recommendations
 

People Management & Leadership

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to define the future of system-level reliability in compute systems.
Apply 
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced System-Level Reliability Researcher to join our team. In this position, you will play a key role in developing methodologies to evaluate and improve the reliability of advanced compute architectures. You will focus on how hardware faults, degradation effects, and technology-level reliability observations translate into system-level behavior, application correctness, availability, and product lifetime. 

This R&D role focuses on compute system architecture, reliability modeling, and resilience evaluation. You will collaborate with experts from the technology, device, circuit, and design domains to translate lower-level reliability information into architectural fault models, simulation inputs, and system-level reliability metrics. 
 

Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 

• Developing system-level reliability assessment methods for processors, accelerators, memory subsystems, SoCs, and chiplet-based architectures.  

• Creating architectural fault models and abstractions based on reliability information provided by lower layers of the technology stack.  

• Building and using simulation, emulation, and fault-injection frameworks to study fault propagation, error masking, and application-level impact.  

• Quantifying reliability outcomes such as Silent Data Corruption, detected errors, service interruptions, availability loss, and lifetime-related degradation at the system level.  

• Evaluating Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) mechanisms, including error detection, containment, recovery, redundancy, and graceful degradation techniques.  

• Studying workload-dependent reliability behavior under realistic execution conditions and operating profiles.  

• Connecting technology-informed fault characteristics with system architecture models to support reliability-aware design decisions.  

• Collaborating closely with colleagues within and outside CSA to interface with workload models, architectural simulators, circuit-level reliability data, and technology-level observations.  

• Contributing to research publications, partner discussions, etc.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with strong R&D experience in system-level reliability.  

• You have 6+ years of relevant experience in industry and/or academia (we encourage you to apply if you have slightly less experience but strong alignment with the role).  

• You have a strong background in compute system architecture and microarchitecture.  

• You have a good understanding of core concepts in system-level reliability, resilience, and dependability, including:  
 

•  
 

•  Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) architecture    
 

•  
 

• Fault tolerance and resilience techniques    
 

•  
 

• Error detection, containment, recovery, and graceful degradation    
 

•  
 

• Fault propagation and architectural error masking     
 

• You have experience developing architectural models, quantitative analysis frameworks, or system-level evaluation methodologies.  

• You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, including statistical analysis, data interpretation, and uncertainty-aware reasoning.  

• You have hands-on experience designing and executing experiments to derive insights from complex system behavior.  

• You are able to collaborate across disciplines and abstraction layers, translating reliability information from technology, circuit, and design teams into meaningful architectural models and system-level insights.  

• You have the knowledge and experience with good software and research engineering practices (e.g., version control, reproducibility, automation, testing, documentation).  

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence.  

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership.  

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges.  

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

• You express yourself fluently in English, both orally and in writing, and have a basic knowledge of Dutch or French

• Authentication & Encryption: Strong knowledge of oAuth2, TLS, and related security protocols.
• Security-First Mindset: Proven ability to integrate security as a foundational element in enterprise architecture.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware memory/storage subsystems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 

We are looking for an experienced Memory/Storage Engineer/Researcher to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong R&D background in memory and/or storage subsystem architecture or design in a larger compute system, with relevant academic/industry experience. We will expect you to bridge the gap between memory/storage technology and architecture to lead deep-tech research ideas towards high-impact innovations in our team.
 

What you will do
 
 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in applications, technology, circuits and design (across imec) towards R&D of novel memory/storage solutions in a system. 

• Conduct feasibility studies through performance modeling and prototyping to provide insights on the design and implementation of next-gen memory/storage subsystems. 

• Engage in R&D activities within project teams to take research ideas towards higher maturity levels, solving hands-on technical and engineering challenges in the process. 

• Develop and customize memory and/or storage subsystem models (functional and/or performance) for complex SoCs/systems for various application domains, as needed. 

• Stay up to date with the advancements in memory/storage subsystems across current domains, specifically in terms of novel technologies, design, integration paradigms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed. 

• Supervise or assist in mentoring Masters/Doctoral students/interns when necessary, and contribute to improved ways of working and shared knowledge across CSA. 

• Publish relevant results and artefacts in high-impact journals, conferences, seminars and open-source ecosystems to highlight CSA contributions to the community. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with hands-on memory/storage architecture/design experience. 

• You have 3+ years of R&D experience in the industry in architecting and/or designing memory/storage components and/or compute-near-memory/storage compute engines; 

• You have been actively involved through ideation to innovation/productization in one or more of your experiences in architecting and/or designing memory subsystems. 

• You have a deep understanding of memory/storage architecture and design principles, with experience in system-level performance modeling and analysis methodologies. 

• You have hands-on expertise in high-level performance modeling (C/C++, systemc, gem5, etc.) and/or low-level prototyping (EDA tools, ASIC design flows, etc.). 

• You have familiarity and/or experience with memory/storage technology innovations and/or memory interfaces/controllers and/or compute-near-memory/storage engines. 

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence. 

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership. 

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges. 

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

1 Master Thesis - Brillouin-Active Integrated Photonics (all genders) // Job-ID: 244-0 
Praktikum/Werkstudium, Vollzeit · VILLACH

Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. This thesis focuses on advanced optical modulation techniques and experimental characterization of photonic systems. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation. The work combines numerical modeling, hands-on experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations using heterodyne measurement techniques. If you are eager to deepen your expertise in integrated photonics, optical modulation, and experimental photonics, this thesis offers an excellent opportunity to develop strong technical and research skills. 
Your Tasks Will Include:

 * Development and analysis of integrated photonic modulation schemes:
 ** Conducting a focused literature review on coherent optical modulation and photonic integrated circuits.
 ** Implementing and analyzing IQ modulation schemes for CS-SSB generation.
 ** Investigating and comparing dual-sideband modulation techniques.
 * Experimental characterization of photonic and acousto-optic components:
 ** Characterizing the performance of an acousto-optic modulator (AOM).
 ** Setting up and performing heterodyne measurement experiments.
 ** Analyzing measured data and extracting key performance metrics.
 * Numerical modeling and data analysis using dedicated simulation and scripting tools (e.g., Matlab, Python, Comsol).
 * Documenting results and presenting outcomes in the form of a Master's thesis and internal presentations.

Your profile
 * Bachelor's degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, or a related field, and currently enrolled in a Master's program (EU university), with good academic performance.
 * Preferred skills:
 ** Basic knowledge of integrated photonics and optical modulation formats.
 ** Familiarity with coherent optical systems and RF-optical signal processing.
 ** Hands-on experience with optical laboratory equipment and measurement techniques (heterodyne measurements are an advantage).
 * Experience with Matlab, Python, Comsol, or similar numerical and data-analysis tools.
 * Motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn, with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a research team.
 * Good written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly document and present technical results using standard Microsoft Office tools.

jobs.description:
For a current research project in the fields of data-driven thermal modelling, simulation, and optimization of an industrial production facility with high temperature heat pump integration, the Energy Research Centre at FHV is seeking a PhD researcher to contribute to innovative solutions for the industrial energy transition. 1 Postgraduate at the Energy Research Centre (m/w/d) Dornbirn, 75%

Your Role(s)

 * _ Energy Researcher: You work on scientific questions in the field of sustainable industrial energy systems and develop application-oriented technical solutions

_ Modeler and Analyst: You develop models of thermal energy systems and analyze complex relationships using data-driven and simulation-based approaches

_ Simulation and Optimization Developer: You design and implement simulation and optimization approaches for energy-related applications and processes

_ Project Partner: You collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, actively contributing your expertise to the research project

_ Science Communicator: You document research results, present your work in project meetings, and publish your findings in scientific journals and conference proceedings

_ PhD Candidate: You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to conduct independent research within the framework of a doctoral dissertation at a partner university

Your Qualifications

 * _ You hold a completed Master's degree in a technical field such as Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable discipline.

_ You are passionate about energy-related topics and motivated to contribute actively to solutions for the energy transition.

_ You have good knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python.

_ You work analytically and systematically and enjoy tackling complex technical challenges.

_ You have an interest in applied research and scientific work.

_ You enjoy working in teams and value professional exchange within interdisciplinary research projects.

_ You have good written and spoken English skills.

Your Prospects

 * _ Employment level: 75% (part-time position; active support for completing a doctoral dissertation)

_ Salary: minimum annual gross salary of € 42.155 (75%-employment). Actual compensation depends on qualifications and experience.

_ Online application deadline: 16 September 2026

_ Fixed-term contract: October 2026 - September 2029

_ You can also find our benefits at: http://www.fhv.at/karriere

Our Spirit

 * _ Quality & Innovation: We share knowledge, educate future professionals, conduct research with partners throughout Europe, and help shape the future for coming generations.

_ Individuality & Development: Flexible working models, compatibility of family and career, diversity, and personal development are central values for us.

_ Flexibility & Collaboration: A collegial and appreciative environment, creative freedom, and shared celebrations are part of everyday life on our campus.

We are happy to answer your questions regarding the position or the application process:

 * Good understanding of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems

jobs.description:
Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) - In the network of science and industry, SAL offers research in the areas of Sensor Systems, RF Systems, Power Electronics, System Integration Technologies and Embedded Systems.
SAL - a great ... 1 Pilot Line Process Integration Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 245-0 Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben
In the position as Staff Research Engineer you are the central technical interface across SAL's technology platforms and pilot-line activities. You ensure coherent end-to-end process flows, strong documentation and traceability, and effective coordination between R&D teams, pilot-line technical leads, and SAL MicroFab. You also support external requests by translating them into executable technical scopes.

Your responsibilities include:

 * Cross-platform process integration: maintain an end-to-end overview of process flows and module interfaces (e.g., thin films, lithography, etch, metrology closure) across integrated photonics, MEMS and related technology stacks.
 * Baseline flows & readiness: define and maintain reference flows versus development lanes; support readiness reviews and ensure clear release criteria for stable execution.
 * Process change control & documentation discipline: ensure recipe/version control, run cards, parameter windows, and structured documentation of decisions and learnings.
 * Know-how capture: support structured capture of process know-how and clarify what can be shared externally vs protected, in collaboration with responsible functions.
 * Traceability / data backbone: ensure wafer genealogy, run history, recipe versions, and measurement linkage are consistently captured to build a scalable single source of truth.
 * Coordination interface: act as the key technical coordination contact with SAL MicroFab to align run readiness, documentation requirements, execution constraints, and release criteria (without owning MicroFab operations).
 * Stability & continuous improvement: drive variability reduction and improvement loops (metrology closure, deviation handling, root-cause analysis) and feed improvements back into baseline flows and documentation.
 * External request (open access): support business development and pilot-line teams by translating external requests into executable technical scopes (capability check, feasibility, assumptions/risks, measurement package, deliverables) and matching requests to the right platform capability.

Dein Profil
 * Proven experience (min. 8+ years) in semiconductor process integration and wafer fab execution in an applied R&D / microfabrication environment.
 * MSc/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Microsystems, or comparable.
 * Strong understanding of thin-film and microfabrication process flows and interface points (module integration, variability drivers, metrology closure).
 * Demonstrated strength in documentation discipline; experience with traceability/MES workflows is a plus.
 * Structured, data-driven problem solving (variability/yield thinking, root-cause analysis; SPC/DoE basics appreciated).
 * Strong communication and coordination skills across technical teams in a matrix organization; comfortable interfacing with external partners/users.
 * Fluent English; German is a plus.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group F (F1 salary = EUR 4.757,- paid 14 times a year, based on 38,5 hours per week). A Snapshot of Your Day

As the Head of High Voltage Power Transformer Test Field at our new Siemens Energy Transformers Repair Center in Linz, Austria, you will play a pivotal role within the organization planning, developing, and advising the testing of the power transformer. You will lead employees according to the Company's goals and current regulations and provide the necessary resources. You will ensure and develop your team's specialist knowledge and supply to the development of business processes.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Take charge of the test department by planning and performing power transformer tests in accordance with established standards and customer requirements.

 * Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements throughout the testing process.
 * Analyze testing issues, lead investigations, and collaborate with the engineering department, providing detailed reports to the plant manager.
 * Propose actionable recommendations to enhance test efficiency, optimize processes, and improve testing tools.
 * Communicate and collaborate effectively with internal departments to drive business objectives and deliver timely test results while embodying Siemens Energy's core values of safety and integrity.

 * University degree or equivalent experience in engineering or a related field
 * Several years of hands-on experience in high voltage testing of power transformers or HV components or HV electrical systems.
 * Profound experience in personnel management, demonstrating the ability to lead and develop teams optimally.
 * Proven leadership skills, marked by a strong dedication to achieving results and the capacity to engage and empower team members.
 * Extensive knowledge of testing tools and technologies, as well as electric power testing equipment and system development processes, along with an understanding of IEC and IEEE testing standards.
 * Proficiency in English and German is required for collaboration with internal and external partners.

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment

* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

The Crime, Labor and Inequality Department at the DIW Berlin focuses on the effects of labor market, social, and economic policy on the decisions and behavior of individuals and households. Research in the department is particularly concerned with aspects related to the economic causes and consequences of crime, as well as the potential interactions between crime on the one hand and equal opportunities and distributional issues on the other. The focus lies on microeconomic, empirical research that contributes to an evidence-based discourse. 

 Starting as soon as possible, the DIW Berlin is looking for 

Postdoc (F/M/X)

(Full time/39 hours per week)

Your responsibilities:

- Innovative research in applied microeconomics, especially economics of crime, labor and inequality
- Publication of research articles in leading international journals
- Presentation of research papers at international and national conferences and workshops
- Further knowledge transfer through policy-relevant publication formats
- Active participation in the department’s research and policy analysis environment
- Collaboration with other members of the Crime, Labor and Inequality Department and the DIW Berlin, as well as with national and international cooperation partners

Your qualifications:

- Candidates are expected to hold a PhD in economics or related fields.
- Strong background in applied microeconomics, with research experience in the economics of crime, labor and/or inequality

- Experience working with large datasets and administrative data (experience in collecting data from public agencies and institutions is welcomed)
- Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English (knowledge of German is not necessary but welcomed)

A job at a research institute with around 300 colleagues, where diversity, equal opportunities, and a healthy 

work-life balance guide all areas of work. Flexible work schedules tailored to your needs as well as remote work 

are key parts of our work culture. 

An exciting and varied job where you will gain deep insights into a research institute as well as national and 

international science systems. At DIW Berlin, you will have the perfect opportunity to gain further subject-specific training at an institute where science and politics intersect.

DIW Berlin supports your professional and personal qualification and advancement via internal and external 

career development opportunities and annual performance reviews. 

You are paid according to the collective agreement for the public sector (Tarifvertrag des öffentlichen Dienstes, 

TVöD Bund), which includes an annual bonus as well as a company pension with VBL Ost. 

The office is located in the middle of Berlin-Mitte convenient to public transportation. As a DIW Berlin employee, you are eligible for a reduced VBB-Firmenticket that is partially subsidized. In addition, DIW Berlin offers access to Urban Sports Club, giving you the opportunity to choose from a wide range of sports and fitness activities at a reduced rate.

The position is fixed-term until May 15, 2027. Remuneration is paid according to TVöD Bund, salary group E14. The gross salary range is €5,298.27 to €7,551.78 per month.

**Application and information:**

origin. If you’re interested in the position, we are excited to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel, EMEA Health and Life Sciences (Oracle Health and Life Sciences, Legal) (m/f/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin - Medizinrecht)
jobs.description:
At a time when global technological developments and healthcare regulations are occurring and changing at an unprecedented rate, the success of large, complex global organizations that engage deeply in this space requires a legal/business leader who is deeply steeped in the levers, both public and private that impact this industry. To remain competitive in this rapidly changing landscape, organizations require a skilled legal counsel eager to build deeper expertise in healthcare and life sciences regulation, particularly at the EU level.

In this context, we are seeking a German-qualified lawyer with expertise in software as a medical device and healthcare regulatory law, who will support the senior legal team in managing legal and regulatory requirements in the region, especially Germany and the European Union.

About the business

Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business provides industry-specific software and solutions to healthcare providers, payers, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies, and clinical research organizations. It offers a range of products and services, including cloud-based healthcare platforms, data analytics, electronic health records (EHR), and patient engagement systems. The business aims to help organizations improve patient outcomes, lower costs, and accelerate innovation. By leveraging Oracle's technology and expertise, healthcare and life science organizations can streamline their operations, gain insights from data, and make more informed decisions. Oracle also enables secure and compliant handling of sensitive healthcare data, helping organizations meet regulatory requirements and protect patient privacy. With a focus on digital transformation, Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business empowers the industry to embrace modern technologies and improve overall healthcare delivery.

What you’ll do

As Legal Counsel, EMEA Health and Life Sciences, you will support the senior legal team in driving Oracle’s health and life sciences regulatory strategy and implementation in the region, working closely with senior lawyers in the team, the health and medical device regulatory teams and the health and compliance teams, along with product, sales, and consulting teams to provide succinct legal advise on EU and local regulations related to healthcare tech and life sciences products, emphasizing patient safety as a priority.

Specific Responsibilities include:

- Support in developing and implementing the health and life sciences legal regulatory strategy in the region, with a particular focus on Germany and the European Union, support the advise, and education of Oracle Life Sciences and Health staff on legal and regulatory requirements and policy initiatives.
- Support the advise and provide legal drafting, including preparation of legal memoranda and position papers, on legal regulatory issues impacting our customers’ use of Oracle products with a focus on electronic health records technologies, artificial intelligence and machine learning, software as a medical device, and life sciences clinical research.
- Monitor, research, and summarize relevant legal and regulatory developments, especially at the EU and German national level, and assess their impact on Oracle Health and Life Sciences products and services. Provide legal opinions on regulatory questions as required.
- Draft and review legal correspondence with regulatory authorities and courts, and represent Oracle in administrative proceedings as needed, under supervision of senior counsel.
- Assist in the preparation and submission of legal filings with regulatory bodies and agencies in Germany and the European Union to support Oracle’s health policy initiatives.
- Support the implementation of regulatory strategies to help ensure compliance with software as a medical device regulations within Germany and the EU.
- Contribute to projects promoting patient safety and regulatory compliance with guidance from senior legal and product teams.
- Support the review and implementation of regulatory strategies for evolving AI/ML regulations relevant to health and life sciences within the EU, as needed. Additional Responsibilities
- Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a focus on legal and regulatory requirements under EU and German law.
- Prepare legal research, detailed memoranda, legal opinions, and comprehensive case files for internal and external stakeholders.
- Support documentation and compliance initiatives related to GDPR, EHDS, and other EU health data regulations.
- Collaborate with internal teams, including product development and compliance, to advise on legal and regulatory implications and progress regulatory program goals.

What you’ll bring

- We are seeking a German qualified lawyer (First and Second State Bar Exam (Volljurist)) with 1–3 years of legal experience in healthcare or life sciences, with a demonstrated background in a law firm, the legal department of a company and/or a regulatory authority.
- Knowledge of healthcare tech and life sciences regulatory requirements in Germany and the EU, including administrative processes.
- Proven experience and interest in Medical Devices / Medical Devices Software and AI Regulation.
- Professional demeanor, confidence, and innovation with the ability to effectively communicate with colleagues and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent writing, analysis, negotiation, and research skills.
- Project management and interpersonal skills.
- Business orientation and ability to balance legal considerations with commercial priorities.
- Ability to perform in a fast-paced and continually evolving business environment.
- Fluency in German and English is required; knowledge of additional EU languages is a plus.

Competencies

- Performance, drive, and execution: You demonstrate initiative and take ownership of your work, consistently meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality results while supporting a culture of accountability. Collaboration You actively contribute to team efforts, value different perspectives, and work effectively with colleagues across departments to help achieve shared objectives.
- Communicating for impact: You communicate clearly and professionally, ensuring transparency and understanding in your work and interactions, and effectively support the organization’s goals.
Competitive edge: You stay informed about industry trends and client needs, identifying opportunities to add value and proposing fresh solutions within your area of responsibility.
- Change agility: You adapt quickly to new tasks, processes, and changing priorities, embracing continuous learning and demonstrating flexibility in a dynamic environment.

Mastering complexity: You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, seeking guidance when needed, and contribute to practical solutions for complex issues in your daily tasks. Education First and second German State Bar Exam (or equivalent) is required for this role. Another advanced degree (e.g., Master of Laws or equivalent) is a plus, but not essential.

jobs.occupation: The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as Junior Researcher / Pr (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Junior Researcher / PreDoc (Kiel or Berlin)

We are looking for up to two highly motivated Junior Researchers / PreDocs to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The positions are almost full-time (75-90 percent). One position should be based in Kiel and another one optional in Kiel or in our Research Hub in Berlin. Both positions are linked to the research group by Prof. Christoph Trebesch and his ERC project on Great Power Finance.

The two positions have the following focus, respectively:

1. Digital chokepoints: geopolitical risk and telecom networks
2. International capital flows: great powers and cross-border investments across 200 years 

Your Role 

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research on one or two of the projects. The work will involve extensive data collection and rigorous empirical analysis using historical and contemporary sources. A particular focus of these roles will be archival research and the construction of novel datasets from historical records and documents related to telecommunications, computer science, financial assets and international capital flows.

As part of Christoph Trebesch’s research group, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects in macroeconomics, economic history, and political economy. The positions offer an excellent opportunity to gain advanced research experience, develop strong empirical skills, and contribute to internationally visible academic work.

Your Profile 

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics (completed or close to completion) with very good grades.
- ·         Strong quantitative and empirical skills and experience, particularly:
- For position (1): experience with data on telecommunication and computer science
- For position (2): experience with data on financial assets and/or international capital flows, ideally also historical financial data
- ·         Experience with advanced AI tools and statistical software such as Stata, R, and/or Python.
- ·         Interest in historical research and archival work.
- ·         Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment. 
- ·         Excellent analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality research.
- The working language is English; excellent English skills are therefore required. Some knowledge of German would be useful, but is not important.

We are offering 

The planned contract period is 10 months (starting in the fall of 2026). The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 12 or 13 TV L. The position is part-time between 75-90%.

The Kiel Institute for the World Economy values diversity. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age or sexual orientation. The Kiel Institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/equal-opportunity/) . We promote the professional opportunities of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Women with equivalent qualifications, competence and expertise will be given preference. We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified. 

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

Please submit your application online (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/job-vacancies/junior-researcher-/-predoc-kiel-or-berlin/) using ID-No. “PreDoc_2026”. Please include (i) a letter of interest, (ii) your CV, (iii) one or two work samples (e.g. Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis), (iv) university transcripts, as well as (if applicable) (v) proofs of relevant work experience. Ideally submit just one PDF, including “PreDoc” and your family name as file name. The deadline for applications is September 7, 2026 Application photos should not be included. 

For additional information, please contact Prof. Christoph Trebesch (christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de (https://mailto:christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de) ).

- Design Robust Architecture: Build the infrastructure that powers critical model inputs fed every minute to the dispatch algorithm which shapes experiences for millions of customers across the globe, every single day.

From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

In this role, you will be part of an industry-leading RF Transmitter Systems Engineering team. - Translate system-level and performance requirements into requirements for the TX line-up and TX features, including RF algorithm specifications for RFICs and system firmware.

- Solid theoretical grounding and hands-on experience with classical machine learning techniques (e.g., clustering, dimensionality reduction) applied to regression and classification problems.
- Solid theoretical understanding and hands-on experience with neural networks for regression and classification problems.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate across multicultural, global teams.
