jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher position on monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare at the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our international team working on monitoring animal health and welfare.

The position is for two years and will commence December 1, 2026, or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Management and Modelling. 

The research section Management and Modelling develop methods and tools for herd management to promote animal welfare, green transition, and economic viability. Further, the section integrates, develops, and disseminates knowledge of farm animal management and relationships between actors and animals. Researchers in the section teach BSc, MSc and PhD in animal and veterinary science educations and conduct research-based public advice for national and international authorities on animal welfare and health.

The research section is a dynamic multidisciplinary research group including animal scientists, veterinarians, economists, statisticians, and anthropologists.

The position

We seek a post doc to evaluate data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in all major livestock production systems (cattle, pig and poultry). The post doc will contribute to identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in pig welfare inspection. The post doc will also contribute to the development of training materials in targeting pig welfare inspectors in EU member states.

Your profile

We are looking for a candidate who:

• Holds a PhD or equivalent academic qualifications.
• Has research experience in monitoring animal welfare, health or production on any of the major livestock production systems (cattle, pigs or poultry).
Research tasks

• Evaluating data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in cattle, pig or poultry
• Identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in screening of pig welfare in relation to inspection
• Development and evaluation of training and testing programmes targeting European pig welfare inspectors
The preferred candidate will also engage in and further develop ongoing research and teaching within the Management and Modelling group.

What we offer

• A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal-experimental facilities
• An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
• A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.
Who we are

Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, and health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

ANIVET has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further
information about the department; https://anivet.au.dk/en

Contact

Further information on the position may be obtained from Head of Research Unit, Professor Jan Tind Sørensen, phone: +4520783343, email: jantind.sorensen@anivet.au.dk.

Living in Denmark

Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential family.

Place of employment and place of work

The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

• 
We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

• 
The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

• 
Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

• 
formulation design of suspensions, 

• 
particle size characterization, 

• 
chemical stability studies,

• 
 bioanalysis, and 

• 
in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

• 
Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

• 
Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

• 
Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

• 
Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

• 
Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

• 
Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

• 
Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

• 
The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

• 
Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

• 
Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

• 
Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

• 
Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

• 
Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

• 
Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

• 
Engineering or technical background

• 
Experience working in control centre or operational environments

• 
Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

English at a professional level.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

• 
Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

• 
Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

• 
Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

• 
Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

• 
Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

• 
Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

• 
Hjælpe med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende køkkendrift – også når der er ekstra travlt

Vi søger dig, der

• 
Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Gerne har erfaring med thailandsk eller anden asiatisk gastronomi

• 
Har interesse for eller erfaring med at lede og koordinere et køkkenteam

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt som en del af et hold

• 
Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Kan bevare roen og prioritere opgaver i travle perioder

• 
Har fokus på kvalitet og ensartethed i køkkenet

• 
Gerne har kendskab til woktilberedning, curries og traditionelle thailandske smage

• 
Har forståelse for køkkenhygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

• 
Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til thai er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

En vigtig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

• 
Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og god energi

• 
Mulighed for at arbejde professionelt med thailandsk gastronomi

• 
Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

• 
Varierende arbejdsdage og ansvar i den daglige køkkendrift

• 
Fleksibel planlægning af vagter

• 
Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke er bange for at tage fat, og som gerne vil være med til at udvikle både køkkenet og teamet.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

• 
Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

• 
Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

• 
Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

• 
The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

• 
Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

• 
Postdoctoral research positions

• 
Co-supervision of PhD students

• 
Teaching and course development

• 
Funding applications

• 
Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

• 
Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications. 

• 
Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

• 
References/reference letters may be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

Your next opportunity starts here

You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about

When you join DESMI, you can expect:

Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Technically grounded
• Possess strong leadership and people management skills
• Structured and organized
A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
• Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
• Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
• Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.
Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:

• Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
• Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
• Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
• Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
• Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
• Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
• Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
• Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language
The perks of being at DESMI

• Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
• Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
• Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
• Pension – attractive employer contributions
• Private healthcare and life insurance
• On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
• Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties
What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
• A company that values sustainability and innovation.
We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you our newest team member as a Finance assistant, ready to deepen your expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive finance team? DESMI is an innovative and global company where your ideas matter. We are building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning and making a difference. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Detail-oriented and structured
• Curious and proactive in improving processes
• Comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholder.

A glimpse into the role
As a Finance assistant, you’ll be a key contributor to ensuring accurate and efficient processes across DESMI’s Danish entities and several European subsidiaries. Your role is central in maintaining high data quality, securing timely payments, and supporting internal stakeholders with relevant financial information.

Your role mainly revolves around:

• Administration of customer master data and ensuring accuracy across systems
• Risk assessment and credit insurance for customers
• Written and verbal dunning activities toward customers
• Order release and coordination of collection processes, including handling cases with external debt collection partners
• Close dialogue with Sales and Service to ensure alignment and smooth processes

Your next opportunity starts here
We are looking for someone who is structured, reliable, and able to work independently — while also contributing to a positive and supportive team culture. You enjoy working in a role with broad contact across the organization and take pride in delivering high-quality financial processes.

We also imagine that you:

• Have experience working with mid/large companies within credit assessment, accounts receivable or similar fields, preferable in an international company
• Hold an education within finance, office administration, accounting, or have equivalent practical experience
• Are comfortable working in Excel and have basic familiarity with Word and Outlook
• Preferably have experience with Microsoft Dynamics D365FO (not required but an advantage)
• Communicate confidently in English due to frequent international contact
• Ideally also understand German (not required)

The perks of being at DESMI
At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

• Flexible working hours and good work–life balance
• A collaborative work culture with room for humor, openness and shared solutions
• Opportunities for professional and personal development
• Global career perspectives as part of an international organization
• Access to canteen, sports activities and social events

What we’re about
At DESMI, teamwork and innovation drive success. We have a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together and ideas are always welcome.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve industries worldwide — from Aquaculture and Green Technologies to Defense. We focus on developing high-performance, long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Here, doers thrive — if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

Ready to apply?
If you're a motivated, structured and solution-oriented individual seeking a role where you can contribute directly to DESMI’s financial operations, we encourage you to apply!

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

• 
Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

• 
Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

• 
Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

• 
Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

• 
Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

• 
Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

• 
Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

• 
Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

• 
Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

• 
Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

• 
Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

• 
Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

• 
Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

• 
Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

• 
Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

• 
Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

• 
A friendly and professional team environment

• 
A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

• 
No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

• 
Salary: 200dkk/hr

• 
Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

• 
Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

• 
Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

jobs.occupation: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:

• Cut and prepare premium meat products.
• Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
• Develop new recipes and food products.
• Work with food safety and quality control.
• Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.
After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:

• A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
• A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
• Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
• A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
• Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
• An informal working environment with employee involvement.
• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
• A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.
Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:

• Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
• Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
• Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
• Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
• Can communicate in English.
• Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
• Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.
Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593

• Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
• Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
• Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).
Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?
Send your motivated application to:
Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk
Learn more about us:
https://mmm-rc.dk/
Instagram:
@bornogkolstrup
Learn more about ZBC:
https://www.zbc.dk
We look forward to hearing from you! Application deadline 16/8-26

jobs.occupation: Til vores værksteds- og lagerteam i Hasselager søger vi en der tager fat og kan svejse rustfri/ We're looking for someone to join our workshop and warehouse team in Hasselager - someone who's a go do'er and can weld stainless steel
jobs.description:
English Below.

Hos Alfotech hjælper vi hinanden. Det er ikke bare noget vi siger, det er måden vi arbejder på. Hvis du er typen der ser hvad der skal gøres og gør det uden at blive spurgt, så læs videre.

Hvem er vi

Alfotech er videnscenter for procesindustrien. Vi leverer slanger, fittings, koblinger og specialløsninger til fødevare, pharma og den kemiske industri i hele Europa. Vi har travlt, vi leverer hurtigt, og kvaliteten må ikke svigte.

Hvad du skal lave

Dit primære hjem er værkstedet og lageret under vores teamleder Peter. Du svejser i rustfrit stål når der er ordrer på det, og du er med til at samle, montere, trykprøve og klargøre løsninger fra start til slut. Du dokumenterer i vores ERP-system og svejselog.

Og så er der perioderne imellem. Her hjælper du til i pluk, modtagelse og klargøring af varer, eller der hvor holdet har brug for dig. Det er en fast del af jobbet, ikke en undtagelse.

Hvem vi leder efter

Du har erfaring med TIG-svejsning i rustfrit stål, måske som uddannet rustfri smed eller med baggrund fra et værksted hvor rustfrit var hverdagen. Det er udgangspunktet, resten lærer vi dig. Du er i fysisk god form, møder stabilt op og har en naturlig trang til at bidrage. Du er ligeglad med om opgaven den dag hedder svejsning eller varemodtagelse. Truckkort er en fordel, ellers sørger vi for det.

Arbejdstiden er 7 til 15, fredag kl. 14:30. Du bliver funktionæransat med fast løn. Skal du gå tidligere en dag, finder vi en løsning og du indhenter timerne.

English:

At Alfotech, we help each other. It’s not just something we say—it’s the way we work. If you’re the kind of person who sees what needs to be done and does it without being asked, then read on.

Who We Are

Alfotech is a knowledge center for the process industry. We supply hoses, fittings, couplings, and custom solutions to the food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries throughout Europe. We’re busy, we deliver quickly, and quality must never be compromised.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your primary workstation will be the workshop and warehouse under the supervision of our team leader, Peter. You’ll weld stainless steel when orders come in, and you’ll help assemble, install, pressure-test, and prepare solutions from start to finish. You’ll document your work in our ERP system and welding log.

And then there are the periods in between. During these times, you’ll help with picking, receiving, and preparing goods—or wherever the team needs you. This is an integral part of the job, not an exception.

Who We’re Looking For

You have experience with TIG welding of stainless steel—perhaps as a trained stainless steel welder or with a background in a workshop where working with stainless steel was part of your daily routine. That’s the starting point; we’ll teach you the rest. You’re in good physical shape, show up consistently, and have a natural desire to contribute. You don’t mind whether the task for the day is welding or receiving goods. A forklift license is a plus; if you don’t have one, we’ll take care of it.

Work Hours and Employment

Work hours are 7 a.m. to 3 p.m., with Friday ending at 2:30 p.m. You’ll be hired as a salaried employee with a fixed salary. If you need to leave early one day, we’ll find a solution, and you’ll make up the hours.

Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms.  However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

  As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

  This application is posted with a corresponding PhD position and only one of the positions will be filled. We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with a preference for some knowledge about programming.

  The postdoc’s duties will include research within biophysics as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at the NBI website. Inquiries about the position can be made to Kristian Thijssen, Kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk. 

  Terms of employment
 The two-year position is open from 1 Nov 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically through UCPH Job Portal.

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• 1 page Research plan,  description of current and future research plans 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 31 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process here.

   

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.description:
English below: 

Kok Søges Til Væveriet

Vi søger en dygtig faglært kok eller en kok med tilsvarende udenlandsk erfaring til Væveriet i Dalbygade.

Vi er hovedsageligt et eventkøkken, men laver også kokkeskoler, teambuilding, mad over bål i de varme sæsoner og en god del grill. Vi kører ikke faste, låste menuer året rundt, så der er plads til kreativitet, egne idéer og de retter, du selv brænder for at lave.

Vi er et lille hold med et stærkt sammenhold. Her løfter vi i flok, hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen, også når tempoet stiger.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• 
Er faglært kok eller har tilsvarende udenlandsk erfaring.

• 
Er rigtig god til at lave mad.

• 
Har et solidt grundrepertoire og ikke skal starte med opskriften hver gang.

• 
Har interesse for råvarer, smag og god afvikling.

• 
Kan holde aftaler og møde forberedt.

• 
Er en god kollega og bidrager til fællesskabet.

• 
Har fornuftig fysik og er klar på at knokle, når der er travlt.

• 
Har humor og kan holde hovedet koldt.

• 
Er fleksibel med arbejdstiderne.

• 
Ikke går i panik, fordi der pludselig har sneget sig en ekstra veganer, allergiker eller FODMAP-gæst ind i selskabet.

Du behøver ikke have 15 års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du kan dit håndværk, har lyst til at udvikle dig og elsker følelsen af, at et travlt køkken bare spiller.

Vi er skarpe på tidsplaner, afvikling og varm mad til mange mennesker. Samtidig er vi et hus, hvor der sker meget, så du skal være med på, at vi hjælper hinanden på tværs, når det giver mening. Til gengæld har vi faktisk ret godt styr på tingene.

Arbejdet ligger naturligvis ofte, når andre har fri. Klargøring og forberedelse kan til gengæld i høj grad planlægges fornuftigt.

Vi tilbyder pension, sundhedsforsikring, feriepenge og løn efter kompetencer og ansvarsområder. Arbejder du mange lørdage, tager vi selvfølgelig også en snak om, at lønnen skal afspejle det.

Tiltrædelse snarest, men vi venter gerne på den rigtige profil.

Send en ansøgning til rasmus@vaeveriet.com.

Chef Wanted At Væveriet

We are looking for a skilled trained chef or a chef with equivalent international experience to join Væveriet in Dalbygade.

We are primarily an event kitchen, but we also run cooking classes, teambuilding events, open-fire cooking in the warmer seasons and quite a bit of grilling. We do not work with fixed, locked menus all year round, so there is room for creativity, your own ideas and the dishes you genuinely enjoy making.

We are a small team with a strong sense of community. We help each other, lift together and keep the mood good, even when things get busy.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is a trained chef or has equivalent international experience.

• 
Is genuinely good at cooking.

• 
Has a solid basic repertoire and does not need to start from a recipe every time.

• 
Cares about ingredients, flavour and smooth service.

• 
Keeps agreements and shows up prepared.

• 
Is a good colleague and contributes to the team.

• 
Has decent physical stamina and is ready to work hard when needed.

• 
Has a sense of humour and can keep calm under pressure.

• 
Is flexible with working hours.

• 
Does not panic when an extra vegan, allergy or FODMAP guest suddenly appears on the function sheet.

You do not need 15 years of experience. What matters most is that you know your craft, want to develop and enjoy the feeling of a busy kitchen running well.

We are sharp on timing, execution and serving hot food to large groups. At the same time, Væveriet is a place where many things happen, so you should be willing to help across the house when it makes sense. In return, we are actually quite structured and usually have a good grip on things.

The work naturally often takes place when other people are off. Prep and planning, however, can usually be arranged in a sensible way.

We offer pension, health insurance, holiday pay and salary based on skills and areas of responsibility. If you work many Saturdays, we will of course discuss a salary that reflects that.

Start as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right profile.

Send your application to rasmus@vaeveriet.com.

The Niels Bohr Institute, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen invites applicants for a PhD fellowship in computational modelling of active materials and their environment

  Start date is (expected to be) 1 December 2026.

  The project
 Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms.  However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

  As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

  This application is posted with a corresponding Postdoc position and only one of the positions will be filled.

  Who are we looking for?
 We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with preference for some knowledge about programming.

  Our group and research- and what do we offer?
 As a newly established research group, we utilize state-of-the-art computational models to study pattern formation in microorganisms. By combining discrete solvers, particularly a particle-based mesoscale hydrodynamic solver known as MPCD, with continuum simulations, we aim to characterize the collective dynamics of biological matter, their hydrodynamic interactions, and their influence on adaptable environments. This multiscale approach enables us to explore active systems that actively restructure their surroundings as effective ecosystem engineers.    

  We offer a highly creative and collaborative research atmosphere at the interface between physics, biology and fluid mechanics. Our research facilitates high performance computing facilities and actively encourage cooperation and or collaboration with the researchers who develop the numerical solvers used. The PhD fellowship is given in accordance with Danish legislation and will typically run for 3 years. The salary is set accordingly to Danish Union Contracts which are very competitive within the international academic community.

  Principal supervisor is Dr. Kristian Thijssen, Niels Bohr Institute, kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk.

  Qualifications needed for the PhD programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Physics. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  The terms of employment and salary are in accordance to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Responsibilities and tasks

   	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional activities 	
• Curious mind-set with a strong interest in soft matter systems 	
• Good language skills   Application and Assessment Procedure
 Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor or Master and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Publication list (if possible) 	
• Reference letters (if available)   The deadline for applications is 31 August 2026, 23:59 (CEST)
 We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified, whether you will be passed for assessment.

  The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process here.

  Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in September

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

• 
Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

• 
Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

• 
Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

• 
Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

• 
A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

• 
Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

• 
An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

• 
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk

Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.

Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
